jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

The challenge
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.

These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention.

  • Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

  • Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

  • Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions.

  • Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

  • AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI.

  • Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning.


The Team

You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday.


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end.

  • A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show.

  • Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus.

  • Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking.

  • Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making.

  • Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls.

  • Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

  • Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping.


Who you are

  • Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet.

  • Ambitious and pragmatic: You aim for 100 but ship the smallest thing that proves the next step.

  • Owner: You act without waiting for permission and own outcomes, not output.

  • Customer-obsessed: You'd rather talk to five customers than debate one assumption.

  • Clear communicator: You align engineers, leadership and partners around one simple story.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You make good calls on imperfect data and kill what isn't working, even your own ideas.

  • You're based in or moving to The Netherlands and can be in our office three days a week.


Recruitment process

  1. First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

  2. Hiring manager interview: A deep dive into your experience with our Head of Product.

  3. Case study: Present a practical Calling for Work challenge to the team at our office.

  4. Meet the CEO.

  5. Reference check

  6. Offer

What You Get  

Competitive compensation  

  • 77,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

Learning and growth  

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.  

Time to recharge  

  • 25 vacation days   

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs   

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview)   

Work from anywhere  

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.  

A team you’ll actually want to be part of  

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday   

  • Regular team moments and outings   

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond   

Set up for success  

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work   

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance   

An environment to grow and make impact  

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission.  

About Talk360  

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. 

We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. 

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number.

 

Here’s what our users say:  

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★  

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★  

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Legal Counsel

HEADLINE:
Job Title: Legal Counsel
Reporting to: General Counsel
Location: London - Hybrid-Working: 3 days in office, 2 days from home

ABOUT THE ROLE:
APEXX is pioneering payment orchestration, transforming the global payments landscape with cutting-edge technology and innovation. As a leader in Fintech, we're committed to excellence, driving forward-thinking solutions that empower businesses worldwide.

We are looking for a Legal Counsel to join APEXX’s Legal & Compliance team, providing front-line guidance and support across all areas of the business. You will work closely with our General Counsel and wider business to support a broad range of commercial and legal matters, gaining significant exposure to the day to day operations of a fast-paced, international FinTech. This is a generalist role offering a high level of commercial involvement.

WHAT YOU’LL DOING:

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role supporting the General Counsel with several key elements including:

  • Reviewing, drafting and negotiating a range of complex commercial agreements

  • Delivering legal and strategic advice to different areas of the business on a variety of matters ranging from financial regulation and the payments ecosystem, contracts, negotiations, documentation, client issues, employment, compliance, IP, IT, marketing and data protection

  • Supporting the commercial teams and wider business in discussions with customers, partners and suppliers

  • Identifying legal and regulatory risks related to the introduction of new products and expansion into new markets

  • Helping to identify, prepare and deliver training to the business on relevant legal and commercial issues

  • Delivering continuous improvement in operating practices and processes, identifying inefficiencies and improvement

ABOUT YOU:

  • You’ve done this before: You’ll be a qualified lawyer with some post qualification experience (1-2+ years PQE) ideally working within Startups, FinTech or Payments.

  • You have sound judgement: The ability to provide sound legal advice and exercise good business judgement and to promptly identify, analyse and mitigate risks and issues within the business while maximising commercial opportunities.

  • You think creatively: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to confidently work with stakeholders across the business to achieve objectives.

  • You communicate effectively: Communication is key to the role including being able to advise stakeholders across all parts of the business on challenging legal issues in layman’s terms.

  • You have passion and drive: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high level of competing tasks and tight deadlines and to be adaptable, coping with change quickly.

  • You’re in the detail: Thoroughness and accuracy are pivotal to your role including in drafting, advising on, and negotiating commercial agreements and researching legal issues.

  • You lead from the front: This is a hands-on role, and you will be expected to handle significant and complex legal matters and provide direction across the business, including to senior level stakeholders.

GREAT TO HAVE:

  • You know our domain: Expertise and experience in financial services particularly regulation and licensing processes for the payments industry, with the ability to keep up to date with and share relevant legal and market developments.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

 

💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make.

🏖️ Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work.

🌍 Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 90 days per year, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy.*

❤️ Comprehensive Health Insurance: Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance which includes optical & dental to help support you when it matters most.

🛡️ Life Insurance & Critical Illness Protection: Additional protection for you and your loved ones when it’s needed most.

👶 Enhanced Family Leave: Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.

📈 Learning & Growth: We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

 

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE:

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration.

Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence.

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable.

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX.

To learn more about APEXX and experience the dynamics of being part of our team, feel free to check out the provided media channels below:

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/apexxglobal/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/apexx.global/?hl=en

Main Website: https://apexx.global/

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to encouraging equality, diversity, and inclusion among our employees and eliminating discrimination.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from Recruitment Agencies.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | NORD
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | NORD

At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Enterprise New Logo Account Executive NORDICS is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.

This role is offered in Sweden only, preferably for candidates located and used to travel from the Stockholm area #LI-Remote

What you can expect to do this role:

New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development

  • Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory.
  • Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.
  • Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.

Enterprise Sales Cycle Management

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.
  • Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.
  • Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.

Commercial & Deal Execution

  • Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.
  • Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.
  • Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.

Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.
  • Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.

Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.
  • Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.
  • Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)
  • Professional working proficiency in English and Swedish (required)
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)
  • Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)
  • Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)
  • Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)
  • Travel in the NORDICS territory around 40%.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

Why Jamf?

  • Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.
  • 23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

Senior Enterprise Account Executive - France

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role

Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Enterprise Account Executive to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory and expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for Public Services, where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle for Public Services accounts in France, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline health with discipline, not optimism.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Proven experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end in the French Public Services market, ideally six figures or more, across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked deals with C-suite, IT, legal, and procurement in the room at the same time, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Strong territory and account planning instincts. You can build a plan independently, not just work from a list handed to you, and you know how to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • The ability to sell technical products credibly. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor, and you know what it took to earn that.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $281,300 to $453,500

  • United Kingdom: £176,600 to £290,500

  • Singapore: S$349,400 to S$524,000

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

jobs.title: AI Operations Monitor – Digital Operations & Incident Response
jobs.description:
AI Operations Monitor – Digital Operations & Incident Response

Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection.

We’re looking for reliable, technically minded freelancers to support an AI operations project involving the monitoring of autonomous digital workflows. You'll oversee day-to-day activity, respond to alerts, troubleshoot issues, and intervene when human oversight or approval is required.

This is a remote, four-week freelance contractor opportunity with scheduled shifts across time zones, including nights and weekends.

Tasks

What you'll be doing

  • Monitor autonomous digital workflows and operational activity through a web-based interface, identifying errors, unusual behavior, and situations requiring human intervention

  • Remain available and responsive throughout scheduled shifts, acknowledging urgent alerts in Slack within 10 minutes

  • Handle routine operational requests and troubleshoot issues using established procedures and escalation guidelines

  • Review and approve or deny certain actions within predefined limits, escalating sensitive decisions, financial commitments, or exceptions to authorized team members

  • Investigate incidents by reviewing activity logs, error messages, and system outputs to reconstruct what happened, identify likely causes, and flag anything that cannot be verified

  • Intervene in critical situations, including pausing workflows or escalating potential risks when necessary and permitted by the project guidelines

  • Document incidents, operational issues, and human interventions, maintaining clear records of actions taken, outcomes, and unresolved concerns

  • Provide concise shift handovers, summarizing outstanding issues, important developments, and recommended next steps for the incoming team

The project focuses on monitoring advanced AI systems performing real-world digital operations. Your role is to ensure that activity remains within established guidelines, identify and resolve operational issues, and provide reliable human oversight when automated systems encounter limitations or require approval.

Requirements

You're a strong candidate if you:

  • Have fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely during operational incidents

  • Have experience in technical support, quality assurance (QA), digital operations, IT support, or a similar role involving troubleshooting and monitoring digital workflows

  • Are comfortable using Google Sheets, Excel, Slack, and web-based operational tools to track activity, communicate updates, and document issues

  • Can interpret technical logs, error messages, and structured data, including basic JSON, to investigate problems and identify relevant information

  • Have hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude or Codex, and a basic understanding of how AI systems work and where they may fail

  • Have strong problem-solving skills and sound operational judgment, particularly when deciding whether to intervene, follow established procedures, or escalate an issue

  • Are highly reliable and responsive, with the ability to remain attentive and available throughout agreed shifts, including nights or weekends where applicable

  • Have excellent attention to detail and can accurately document incidents, actions, and outstanding issues

  • Can work independently under time pressure while consistently following operational guidelines and escalation procedures

Preferred qualifications:

  • Previous experience monitoring automated systems, AI agents, or other complex digital workflows

  • Experience with incident management, operational escalation, or technical troubleshooting

  • Familiarity with APIs, automation tools, or basic scripting

  • Experience working in shift-based operations or providing support across multiple time zones

Benefits

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere

  • Hourly freelance contract with scheduled shifts

  • Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge AI operations project involving autonomous systems

  • Gain practical experience monitoring advanced AI workflows and supporting real-world AI deployments

Send us your CV along with your time zone, availability (including any nights or weekends you can cover), and a brief example of a technical or operational issue you've investigated and resolved.

If applicable, we'd also love to know about your experience with AI tools, technical support, incident management, or monitoring automated systems.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
Head of Engineering

Who We Are

Building the AI-first frontier enterprise.

We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first approach-Gen-e2™. It redefines how enterprises build digital products and transform their organizations with AI. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We’re proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

  • We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally (10 countries, 450+ experts from 50+ nationalities)

  • We are becoming an agentic organization, adopting the AI-native operating model we bring to our clients

  • We are robust and resilient (100% independent, 0 debt, founded 2009)

  • We are AI-native professionals who invest in what we believe and work as a collective intelligence

  • We are positive, courageous and deliver at the leading edge

Your Role

As Head of Engineering at PALO IT Labs, reporting directly to the CTO, you are the operational engine of our engineering organisation. You translate strategy into daily execution, lead our AI engineering community, and ensure every team-client-facing or product-side-delivers at the highest standard.

Where the CTO sets direction and makes structural architectural decisions, you make those decisions real. You own the day-to-day: team health, engineering standards, roadmap execution, and the development of our AI engineers. You are the technical authority your teams rely on to unblock, challenge and grow-while the CTO focuses on vision, key clients, and long-term positioning.

Engineering Excellence

  • Deploy the Gen-e²™ technology roadmap defined by the CTO: architecture governance, AI governance, and factory standards (agents, prompts, rules, pipelines) across all squads

  • Own the token economics of our delivery, balancing model cost, latency and quality across squads, so “AI-first” means production-grade, not prototype-grade

  • Operate one level above Lead Engineers: arbitrate divergences, challenge local decisions, spot systemic debt and keep the bar rising as execution becomes increasingly agentic

  • Deploy on our most complex client engagements as the senior technical authority: design AI-first architectures and see them through to production-you ship, not slide decks

  • Step in as Tech Lead on client projects when needed: if a mission requires it, you can take the technical lead role directly, ensuring continuity and quality without waiting for a resource to be available

  • Define and enforce engineering standards: CI/CD practices, code reviews, incident management, and security posture across squads

  • Own technical incidents and escalations with clear ownership and post-mortems

People & Community

  • Directly manage Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and later AI tech leads and - their growth, performance, workload and career paths are yours

  • Own the engineering community’s rituals end to end: critiques, showcases, community days, learning circles and the shared knowledge base that keeps them visible, inclusive and connected to real delivery challenges

  • Foster cross-project collaboration by connecting engineers facing similar challenges, surfacing reusable patterns, and turning field learnings into shared standards

  • Set the community’s norms and health signals: champion psychological safety, experimentation, wellbeing and sustainable pace, and run lightweight pulse checks to catch issues early

  • Build the mentorship engine: create structures and learning pathways for Senior Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers, and grow the technical leadership bench

  • Operate the hiring process for engineering roles: sourcing strategy, interviews, technical assessments and recommendations to the CTO

  • Partner with delivery and staffing teams to maintain visibility of capacity and utilisation, support staffing decisions, and turn bench time into meaningful learning, R&D or community contribution

Gen-e2 Practice & R&D

  • Feed everything back into Gen-e²: what you learn on live engagements becomes standards, artefacts, prompts and learning paths for the whole firm, in collaboration with international teams

  • Produce and own engineering KPIs: velocity, quality, incident rate, technical debt, and team health; report regularly to the CTO

  • Represent the engineering practice in leadership forums and working groups, communicate regularly on team health and needs, escalate risks promptly, and uphold PALO IT values, confidentiality, information security and professional standards

  • Contribute to pre-sales through technical scoping, estimation, proposal input and executive-level advisory, ensuring commercial promises remain grounded in production-grade engineering reality

Who You Are

  • You bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of an engineering organisation or practice (VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Head of Tech, or CTO of a scale-up)

  • You have delivered production-grade AI-first systems, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration-and you think in token economics (cost, latency, quality tradeoffs) as naturally as you think in code. You master AI coding assistants as a force multiplier: you still code, by choice

  • You have led delivery in complex, client-facing environments (consulting, embedded squads, platform modernisation) with real users, real constraints and real accountability

  • You are a proven people developer and manager, with a track record of scaling engineering practices-not just individuals-through mentorship, community-building and hands-on AI adoption

  • You think in systems and write things down: architecture decisions under uncertainty, ADRs, standards that make quality reproducible

  • You are fluent at every altitude, from engineering stand-ups to leadership forums, and you switch between them in the same afternoon

  • You lead with care and exigence: high expectations held with accountability in a psychologically safe environment

  • You know how to read team signals early: engagement, workload imbalance, burnout risk, retention risk and under-utilisation, and you act with care, clarity and accountability

  • You care about Tech for Good: sustainability, accessibility and responsible AI are embedded in how you build

  • You are comfortable partnering with HR on hiring strategy, interviews, portfolio reviews, offer decisions and talent-pipeline building through community engagement and events

  • Bilingual French/English, English is mandatory for client and international collaboration

  • Nice to have: cloud architecture certifications (AWS SA, GCP/Azure Professional), public speaking or publications on AI-first delivery

More About PALO IT 

Our mission is to become the most advanced consulting company when it comes to AI-First product and software engineering. 100% of our projects are focused on deploying our Gen-e2 methodology to clients to help them accelerate delivery and scale those new practices. 

 

  • A playground matching your expertise: missions chosen for their complexity, engineering excellence, and meaningful business and societal impact.

  • Dedicated career coaching with regular development check-ins and goal support.

  • A demanding yet supportive technical community: code reviews, pair programming, mentoring to raise development craft daily.

  • Gen-e²™ skill ramp-up from week 1, fully integrated onboarding.

  • Funded Microsoft and GitHub certifications.

  • From idea to impact: internal R&D labs, default open source culture, tech conferences, and innovation dojos to experiment and share.

 

…Plus

  • Global career opportunities with cross-sector and multi-country missions, connecting 11 offices worldwide.

  • Remote-friendly arrangements depending on project needs, alternating client sites and Paris office for team collaboration.

  • Impact Academy: training on climate, digital responsibility, and accessibility embedded in everyday practices.

  • Solidarity engagements: team volunteering, skills sponsorship, and more.

  • Benefits including Swile meal vouchers and Alan health insurance.

For more on our team culture and benefits, check out our careers page. 

PALO IT Labs is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions will be based on merit, qualifications and abilities. PALO IT Labs does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexuality, national origin, age, disability, marital status or any other characteristics protected by law. 

Protecting your privacy and the security of your data are longstanding top priorities for PALO IT. Your data will be processed to manage PALO IT’s recruitment-related activities. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.palo-it.com/en/privacy-policy) to know more about how we collect, use, and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Software Engineer - Agent Team

Are you ready to own something big? Automox is turning IT admins into IT heroes by replacing traditional tools with our award winning cloud-native endpoint management platform. Our product works autonomously and so do our teams. We value a ‘one team’ mentality where everyone’s unique skills contribute to an environment that encourages collaboration and ownership. At Automox you’re enabled to do your best work, grow your career, and have an impact that will be noticeable. WE ARE A_TOMOX… all that’s missing is U!

OUR TECH STACK

  • Backend Languages: Go, TypeScript, Java, PHP
  • Frontend Languages: TypeScript, Vue 3, Tauri (Rust)
  • Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, MacOS
  • Databases/Data Tools: PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, S3

OVERVIEW

Our Engineering team builds products that autonomously manage endpoint configuration, security, and patching across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices. We value a "one team" mentality, empowering our engineers with autonomy, collaboration, and meaningful ownership of impactful solutions. At Automox, you’ll do your best work, grow your career, and see the direct impact of your contributions.

You are a curious software developer who is dedicated to your craft and enjoys solving big problems; you write code that you are proud of and can hit the ground running with support from the team. You understand that SaaS software delivery necessitates innovation and speed of execution. You want to be a part of a creative and enterprising team with challenging problems to solve. You pride yourself in owning problems but don’t want to work in a vacuum to solve them. Collaborating with the team to come up with the best solution for your customer is what fuels your fire.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Research, design, develop, secure and solutions that facilitate communications with over 2 millionAutomox agents deployed globally.
  • Extend, enhance, and evolve event driven services to provide new and exciting features in the Automox platform and in our endpoint software.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by testing, performance tuning, refactoring, making usability improvements, and automation.
  • Evaluate technical options, make a clear recommendation, and move forward in a way that invites feedback and iteration.
  • Operate with a quality-first mindset. Your approach to testing sets you apart from your peers.
  • Make data-driven decisions. You understand the impact of your development before it reaches production.

BACKGROUND AND SKILLS REQUIRED

  • Programming experience in Golang or Java is preferred although we'll consider polyglots. The right candidate will show versatility writing and developing software in a variety of languages over their career.
  • 3 - 5 years of experience designing, developing, testing, and monitoring applications deployed in a high availability SaaS environment.
  • Professional experience shipping frontend features in a modern JavaScript framework using TypeScript. You don’t need to be a UI specialist, but you should be comfortable owning the UI half of a feature you built the backend for.
  • Experience building production applications in cloud environments (AWS) with a strong emphasis on security best practices.
  • Enjoy scaling microservice architectures and large-scale event ingestion platforms. Have familiarity scaling websockets, real-time messaging systems (Kafka, MQTT), and non-relational database systems like DynamoDB, and DevOps.
  • Excellent communicator, thrives within a tightly knit, cross-functional remote team environment.
  • Impactful collaborator working with other engineers, Product Managers, Program Managers and Technical Support.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience building desktop or cross-platform applications.
  • Experience with software that runs on customer endpoints across macOS, Windows, or Linux (such as agents, installers, or system services).
  • Experience writing automated end-to-end tests (Python, Playwright, or similar)

How We Work

We run a 70/20/10 model across our engineering pods: 70% of sprint capacity goes to primary roadmap, 20% to tech debt and service health, and 10% to learning and exploration. That last 10% is protected — it's how we invest in our engineers and stay sharp as a team.

We're moving toward full service ownership, where the team that builds it, runs it. That means you'll understand your services at a level most engineers don't get to — cost profiles, failure modes, operational behavior — and you'll have the autonomy to make them better.

We have an Architecture Review Board (led by our Principal Engineer) that provides guardrails and review for significant technical decisions. You'll have input there as your experience grows.

The salary range listed is the base pay range for this position. In addition, the total compensation package includes bonus, equity and benefits. Actual earnings may be less or more depending on a candidate's direct experience, skills, industry knowledge, and location.

Compensation

$122,000—$160,000 USD

LOCATION

We are a fully distributed company of remote employees.

***Note: We currently don't hire in California or New York metro***

ABOUT AUTOMOX

Automox is the cloud-native IT operations platform for modern organizations. Our award-winning answer to modern IT operations and best-in-class results earned Automox four straight quarters of record growth. We are now trusted by more than 2,500 leading companies and MSPs worldwide, including NASA, Yale, Xerox, Allbirds, and Unicef. It makes it easy to keep every endpoint automatically configured, patched, and secured – anywhere in the world. The future of IT Operations is cloud-native – and right now. Will you join us?

EMPLOYMENT AT AUTOMOX

✅ Complete a local in-person verification

TOTAL REWARDS: Thrive with Us

Happiness & Well-Being

Stage Assistant·e coordination de projet événementiel séminaire international
jobs.description:
Stage Assistant·e coordination de projet événementiel séminaire international

Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Assistant·e de coordination de projet événementiel pour le Séminaire international « Aides techniques et inclusion » (Dakar, juin 2027).

Contexte :

Titre de travail du séminaire : « Une offre de services de qualité en aides techniques : un pilier pour l’inclusion intersectorielle ».

Le séminaire vise à construire et partager une approche commune de HI et de ses partenaires sur l’offre de services de qualité en aides techniques (identification, orientation, évaluation, adaptation, information et conseil aux usagers et aux aidants). Il couvre la mobilité, la vision, l’audition et la communication, et s’adresse aux secteurs de la réadaptation, de l’éducation inclusive et des moyens de subsistance.

Il s’inscrit dans l’accord-cadre (AC) 2023–2027, qui appuie 16 pays : en Afrique (Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Éthiopie, Mali, Niger, Madagascar, RDC, Rwanda) et hors Afrique (Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Cambodge, Laos, Myanmar, Népal, Palestine, Haïti). L’invitation pourra être ouverte à d’autres pays disposant de leurs propres sources de financement.

Il est organisé en articulation avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027, premier dialogue international dédié à l’innovation, à la production et à l’accès aux aides techniques en Afrique, qui se tiendra sur le même site les 3–5 juin 2027 (Journée mondiale des aides techniques le 4 juin). Dates, agenda et logistique des deux événements sont à coordonner.

Cadre du stage :

Le stage se déroulera à Lyon, avec un déplacement à Dakar (Sénégal). Vous êtes intégré à l'équipe de la Direction Réadaptation, composée de 12 personnes, incluant des spécialistes thématiques (dont 1 manager), des spécialistes de la réadaptation en urgence (dont 1 manager), une unité de reconditionnement de composants (avec 1 chef d’atelier), un adjoint à la direction et 1 assistante.

Vos principaux interlocuteurs seront :

•    Le point focal en charge du contenu et de l’animation du séminaire (binôme de travail au quotidien)

•    Les points focaux de HI Luxembourg et de HI Sénégal (logistique, finances, sécurité)

•    Le point focal de la Division Résilience & Inclusion (éducation inclusive, moyens de subsistance)

•    Les points focaux des pays de l’accord-cadre et le point focal de AT EXPO AFRICA 2027

•    Les services communication, achats et finances de HI

Vos missions principales :

Une phase d’intégration est prévue en début de stage : procédures HI, règles de sécurité, code de conduite et politiques de protection.

Axe 1 – Coordination et pilotage opérationnel

•    Participer à la réunion de cadrage avec la tutrice, le point focal contenu et animation et les autres points focaux ; clarifier les rôles et les circuits de validation

•    Reprendre et tenir à jour le rétroplanning et le plan d’action ; identifier les moyens nécessaires (budget, transport, salles, documentation, outils de présentation…)

•    Assurer le secrétariat du comité d’organisation : préparation des réunions, comptes rendus, suivi des décisions

•    Tenir un tableau de bord partagé (avancement, risques, points de blocage) et alerter rapidement la tutrice en cas de difficulté

Axe 2 – Participants et parties prenantes

•    Consolider la liste des participants (pays de l’AC, secteurs, partenaires, intervenants externes) à partir des premiers échanges déjà tenus avec les points focaux pays

•    Préparer et envoyer les invitations et lettres d’invitation pour les visas ; gérer les inscriptions

•    Mettre en place et tenir l’outil de suivi des participants (vols, visas, hébergement, contacts, besoins spécifiques), dans le respect de la protection des données personnelles

•    Recenser les besoins d’accessibilité et organiser les aménagements raisonnables (accès des lieux, formats accessibles, accompagnants, interprétation)

•    Recueillir les attentes des participants en amont ; concevoir, administrer et analyser l’évaluation du séminaire

Axe 3 – Logistique et achats

En lien étroit avec les points focaux de HI Luxembourg et les équipes logistiques de HI Sénégal :

•    Finaliser le choix du lieu (déjà en discussion avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 et HI Sénégal), réserver les salles et l’hébergement ; négocier les tarifs et préparer avec le lieu tous les arrangements nécessaires

•    Organiser les déplacements : billets d’avion des participants et intervenants, visas, transferts aéroport, transport local

•    Organiser l’interprétation et les équipements techniques (sonorisation, connexion pour d’éventuels participants à distance)

•    Sélectionner et suivre les fournisseurs selon les procédures d’achat HI ; commander le matériel, les impressions et les supports

•    Préparer la logistique de la visite de terrain et des temps communs avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027

•    Pendant le séminaire : faire un point quotidien avec l’équipe d’organisation et le lieu, gérer les imprévus et remonter les problèmes

Axe 4 – Suivi budgétaire et administratif

•    Contribuer au budget prévisionnel détaillé ; suivre les engagements et les dépenses au regard du budget et des codes d’imputation

•    Gérer les per diem, avances et remboursements des participants ; collecter les justificatifs

•    Après le séminaire : clôturer les paiements fournisseurs, préparer les éléments financiers du rapport bailleur et transmettre les dossiers en cours

Axe 5 – Contenu, documentation et capitalisation

En appui au point focal en charge du contenu et de l’animation du séminaire :

•    Contribuer à l’élaboration de l’agenda avec les parties prenantes et AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 (consolidation, gestion des versions, traductions)

•    Appuyer les intervenants et facilitateurs dans la préparation des outils d’animation, des présentations et du matériel

•    Produire le kit participant : agenda final, note logistique, informations pratiques sur Dakar, santé et sécurité, per diem, contacts

•    Prendre des notes pendant les sessions et centraliser les ressources (présentations, documents) sur un espace partagé

•    Rédiger le rapport du séminaire (plus spécifiquement le rapport au bailleur) avec le comité d’organisation ; contribuer à la compilation des outils et approches pour la note d’orientation

Axe 6 – Communication

•    Interne : informer les équipes via les canaux HI (Hinside, Teams, réseaux métiers)

•    Externe : rédiger et/ou traduire en anglais des articles et publications (LinkedIn Rehabilitation), en lien avec le service communication et AT EXPO AFRICA 2027, en respectant les règles de visibilité du bailleur

•    Assurer le lien avec les intervenants externes (experts, chercheurs, partenaires)

Et mettre en œuvre toute autre action nécessaire à la bonne organisation du séminaire.

Calendrier indicatif :

La préparation sera déjà engagée à l’arrivée du/de la stagiaire : lieu en discussion avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 et HI Sénégal, premiers échanges tenus avec les pays participants. Le/la stagiaire enclenchera directement l’achat des billets d’avion et les démarches de visas.

•    Janvier : intégration, reprise du rétroplanning et du budget, lancement des billets d’avion et des démarches de visas

•    Février – mars : invitations et inscriptions, finalisation du lieu et choix des prestataires, suivi des visas, communication de lancement

•    Avril – mai : contrats prestataires, recueil des attentes, agenda finalisé, kit participant et supports

•    ~24 mai – 6 juin : à Dakar : installation et briefing, séminaire (31 mai ou 1er juin – 5 juin), AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 (3–5 juin), débriefing

8 – 25 juin : clôture financière, analyse de l’évaluation, rapport, passation

Contraintes particulières liées au stage :

•    Déplacement terrain : Dakar, Sénégal, environ deux semaines (~24 mai – 6 juin 2027). L’établissement d’enseignement doit valider ce déplacement en amont. Passeport valide et vaccinations à jour requis ; respect des règles de sécurité HI.

•    Pic d’activité dans les semaines précédant le séminaire et pendant celui-ci : horaires pouvant être décalés, dans le respect du cadre légal des stages.

•    Environnement multi-site et multilingue : Lyon, Bruxelles, Luxembourg, Dakar et 16 pays ; nombreux échanges à distance.

Engagement à respecter le code de conduite de HI et ses politiques de protection (exploitation et abus sexuels, protection de l’enfance, anti-fraude et anti-corruption, protection des données).

Requirements

Vous êtes issu d'une formation Master en gestion de projets de solidarité internationale, action humanitaire et développement, affaires internationales, management d’événements ou logistique, ou équivalent.

Une première expérience en organisation d’événements (séminaires, conférences, formations), idéalement à dimension internationale, est un atout (stage, emploi ou engagement associatif)

Une expérience dans le secteur des ONG et/ou en Afrique de l’Ouest est appréciée

Une connaissance ou une expérience du milieu de la santé et du handicap est appréciée.

Planification et suivi de projet :

•    Organisation logistique et suivi budgétaire de base (rétroplanning, tableaux de suivi)

•    Très bonnes capacités de communication et de rédaction en français et en anglais (comptes rendus, rapports, articles)

•    Capacité de synthèse et prise de notes

Savoir-être :

•    Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et des priorités

•    Autonomie, esprit d’initiative, capacité à résoudre les problèmes

•    Aisance relationnelle, diplomatie et goût pour le travail en équipe multiculturelle, y compris à distance

•    Réactivité, sang-froid et adaptabilité face aux imprévus

Environnement informatique :

•    Maîtrise du pack Office, notamment Excel (tableaux de suivi, budget)

•    Outils collaboratifs Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint) et visioconférence

•    Formulaires et enquêtes en ligne (MS Forms, KoboToolbox…)

•    Usage raisonné des outils d’IA générative (traduction, synthèse, rédaction), dans le respect des règles de confidentialité de HI

•    Outils de création graphique simples (Canva…) : un plus

Les participants seront francophones et anglophones, voire hispanophones. Toutes les communications orales et écrites se feront au minimum en français et en anglais.

Benefits

Durée: 6 mois à temps-plein

Date de démarrage : à partir du 04/01/2027

Type de contrat: Stage

Salaire: - Gratification mensuelle de 693€

- Tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge)

- Participation de 50% à votre abonnement au titre des transports

Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français.

Les stages proposés chez HI donnent l’occasion aux étudiants d’évoluer dans une organisation internationale et de prendre part à l’action d’Humanité & Inclusion. Nous considérons que les stagiaires pour qui l’expérience s’est bien passée sont nos talents de demain !  

POUR POSTULER :

Merci d’envoyer votre CV et Lettre de motivation à : -----

jobs.description:
Level Design - Puzzle (Turkish Speaker)

Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The team

You join an 8-person puzzle studio in Istanbul, founded by Peak and Zynga alumni. It's backed by Homa's puzzle, data, art, and UA teams. Its new puzzle game is heading to global launch, and fresh levels are now its biggest growth lever.

The opportunity

You own the levels players see every week. You work every day with Homa's product director and the studio's level designers, artists, and engineers. You use a level editor and AI tools that generate layouts and estimate difficulty. AI makes you faster, and you stay the brain behind every level. You work remotely from Türkiye. The team is small, and the bar is high.

As the studio grows, you can own a family of mechanics or a pack of levels. You can also lead a group of level designers, or move toward a product role.

Your responsibilities

  • Build. Your levels keep fresh content reaching players, every single week.
  • Tune. Your difficulty curve makes levels feel hard but fair, so players keep trying.
  • Introduce. New mechanics land smoothly because your levels teach them step by step.
  • Test. You play every level before release, so players only see levels that work.
  • Optimize. You use win rate, attempts and churn data to turn weak live levels into strong ones.
  • Shape. Your ideas on new mechanics and content push the game forward.

As one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies, BLP is entering its next phase of growth with the backing of Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a minority growth investor. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we are expanding our presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

  • What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

  • Where you'll work. You join the Product Core Team, about 12 engineers. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns, and with the frontend engineers who build the UIs on top of your APIs.

  • What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

What you'll do

  • Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

  • Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

  • Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

  • Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including their audit trail.

  • Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and the APIs behind our admin UIs, so customers and project managers can run them on their own.

  • Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

  • Own it end-to-end. From design through the Go service to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

We're excited about you because

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a backend developer, building and operating systems in production.

  • You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects.

  • You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

  • You work well across teams. You align with product, frontend, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

  • You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

  • You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

  • You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

Strong plus

  • Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

  • Experience running multi-tenant systems.

  • Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get

  • Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

  • Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

  • Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

jobs.description:
Partner Engagement Manager, U.S. Army Europe and Africa

Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Secret clearance

In person in Grafenwöhr, Germany

 

Why This Role Exists

As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.

 

What You’ll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

  • Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

  • Lead or support exercises.

  • Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

  • Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.

  • When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

  • Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

  • Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in leading operational planning within a military context, preferably at multi-star headquarters.

  • Exposure to large staff planning, through classical training in Professional Military Education or through service experience

  • Familiarity and experience with major military planning exercises and the protocols for software deployment on classified networks.

  • Proven ability to expand business presence within a customer location with emphasis on software or technology solutions.

  • Experience in customer support, both face-to-face and remote, and capability to respond to incidents coordinating with customers and product engineering teams.

  • Strong technical skills to master our application, troubleshoot issues and liaise with customers on technical matters.

  • Proven ability to navigate large government organizations, solve bureaucratic challenges, and deliver successful outcomes.

  • You hold a current Secret clearance with eligibility for upgrade to Top Secret and have the ability to access DOD facilities and installations.Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

  • Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

  • You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

  • You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.

 

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

  • Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

  • Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (Forward-leaning/ bias for action)

  • Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (Adaptability/ Humility)


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

At Instagrid you are part pf the clean-tech revolution by inspiring people to become part of our green-tech revolution as well as empowering the InstaCrew to bring their innovational mind-sets to life and fulfill our purpose to liberate clean energy now.

Your Mission

Help us build the organisation that accelerates the energy transition. As a Senior People Business Partner, you'll

enable leaders to build high-performing teams that help us scale faster and bring clean, reliable power to more

people. You'll own a broad set of leader relationships across our organisation, help us build a genuine performance

culture, and grow our leadership capability. You'll do this in a global, fast-moving scale-up where the bar is high

and the pace is real.

What you’ll own

Leader Partnerships:

  • Own a broad portfolio of leader relationships across functions and levels from Heads of to VP - as a genuine thought partner, not a service provider.

  • Translate business context into people priorities: org questions, team dynamics, capability gaps, hiring decisions.

  • Handle ER cases, employment questions, probation conversations, manager coaching with good judgment and speed.

Drive Performance Culture:

  • Lead the rollout and execution of our performance cycle.

  • Build the muscle of ongoing feedback and honest performance conversations across the organisation.

  • Support leaders in making timely, fair to the person/fair to the business, well-reasoned people decisions.

Leadership & L&D:

  • Co-own and grow our leadership development offer: Action learning sets, new manager foundations, ad hoc enablement.

  • Identify capability gaps and design pragmatic interventions.

Talent & Organisation:

  • Partner on org design questions, headcount decisions, and role scoping as the business evolves.

  • Support hiring quality.

  • Own job architecture maintenance and levelling as we grow.

Drive Change:

  • Use AI to redesign how P&C works from how we run processes to how we support leaders.

  • Keep raising the bar by constantly looking for ways to automate, simplify, and rethink how People & Culture operates through AI.

  • Initiate continuous process improvements, based on the opportunities you spot, with adjacent teams within and around P&C.


  • At least 4 years of business partnering experience sitting at the leadership table, not just supporting.

  • You've successfully partnered with leaders in complex, fast-changing organisations.

  • Performance culture isn't a concept to you - you've lived it, built it, and you think it's healthy.

  • You partner with leaders as a peer: you challenge, push back, and bring a point of view. You do not shy away from the difficult conversations.

Your benefits

  • Flexible work schedule

  • 30 vacation days plus 5 special leave days and 5 baby leave days

  • Discounts on sustainable online shops

  • Join a company at the forefront of innovation

  • Provision of a MacBook

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.
