Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu conduis les phases de Discovery de bout en bout. Entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins, personas et benchmarks : tu identifies les problèmes réels pour construire les solutions qui comptent.

  • Tu pilotes la conception et la delivery. En collaboration avec les designers et les équipes techniques, tu animes le cycle de vie produit (backlog, roadmap, story mapping) avec une rigueur orientée valeur.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Tu interprètes toi-même les insights, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Une vraie maturité data, c'est ce qui distingue les PM junior des PM qui créent de la valeur.

  • Tu mesures l'impact. Tu définis et analyses les KPI et OKR pour t'assurer que le produit sert les objectifs business, tout en animant les rituels agiles pour maintenir une dynamique d'équipe exemplaire.

  • Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 41.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.


👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux. Ou tu es PO confirmé avec une vraie volonté de progresser vers une posture PM complète (discovery, stratégie, pilotage d'impact).

  • Tu es à l'aise avec le pilotage de backlog, la roadmap et tu possèdes une culture data marquée. Ton orientation valeur est ton moteur au quotidien.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

Software Engineer, Payments

Lemonway is an authorised payment institution at the heart of Europe’s new digital economy.

We secure payments for crowdfunding platforms, the collaborative economy, marketplaces, and e-commerce businesses, with a strong commitment to fraud prevention and the protection of customer funds.

Regulated by the French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR) and benefiting from the European passport in 29 countries, Lemonway is based in Paris and brings together 150 multicultural and committed Lemonheroes.

More than 400 marketplaces trust us with their payments. We manage 1.4 million user wallets and have raised €50 million from Breega, Speedinvest, and Toscafund.

Profitable for the past four years and growing by 25% in 2025, Lemonway aims to remain one of Europe’s leading payment providers through healthy and sustainable growth.

  • Industry: FinTech and online payments

  • Location: Paris, France, in the Sentier district, 2nd arrondissement

  • Remote work: Up to two days per week, with flexibility


Your mission

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payments Tribe, a critical part of our platform powering the payment experience across channels. You will report to the Engineering Manager of the Tribe and work closely with eight engineers across two squads: Core Banking and Payments.


You will drive the enhancement of our platform by specifying, implementing, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting the services provided to our customers. You will work across payment APIs, payment processing, reconciliation, and core banking systems.

This role combines technical craftsmanship, teamwork, and a product mindset within a Tribe that is central to both current and future projects for Lemonway. You will actively contribute to delivering our next-generation card payment stack for acquiring and issuing, as well as our cash management platform.

Your responsibilities

Technical craftsmanship

  • Deliver features that can evolve, finding the right balance between code quality and delivery time.

  • Review code with the Tribe’s best practices and architectural decisions in mind.

  • Cultivate a continuous learning mindset by staying up to date with the latest ecosystem trends, experimenting with new patterns, and actively sharing your technical insights to elevate the Tribe’s engineering standards.

Domain ownership

  • Take ownership of the products we develop and contribute to all stages of the development cycle, from specification to resolving production issues affecting our clients.

  • Deep dive into our complex payment ecosystem. Question assumptions, challenge the status quo, and leverage your domain knowledge to build robust solutions.

  • Understand the “why” behind the “what”: bridge the gap between technical implementation and business value, ensuring that our payment flows directly contribute to Lemonway’s operational success and client satisfaction.

Teamwork

  • Collaborate closely with software, QA, and infrastructure engineers to solve technical challenges, as well as with product managers to deliver new features.

  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues working from the office, remotely, and from nearshore locations.

  • Strike the right balance between investigating independently and asking teammates for help, while remaining solution-oriented in your approach.


Your qualifications

  • You are curious about emerging engineering tools, including AI-assisted development, and use them thoughtfully to improve productivity, quality, and learning.

  • You have professional experience developing services with modern .NET and C#, and working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, RabbitMQ, Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • You understand distributed systems and microservice architectures, and have applied approaches such as Domain-Driven Design and Hexagonal Architecture.

  • You are fluent in French and have a good command of English, which is a strong asset in our international environment.

  • Nice to have: Knowledge of payment processing in a regulated environment.

** If you do not meet all the requirements, but believe you can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply.

  • Swile meal vouchers.

  • Alan health insurance.

  • Access to Gymlib.

  • Syntec holiday bonus and RTT days.

Lemonway is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion, including gender equality and the employment of people with disabilities.

jobs.title: Account Executive Tender (Non-profit) & RFPs
jobs.description:
Account Executive Tender (Non-profit) & RFPs

In de non-profit-, overheid- en onderwijswereld draait alles om impact en vertrouwen. Het proces is gestructureerd en verloopt stap voor stap, maar tenders zijn complex en relaties zijn cruciaal. Zo'n 30% van onze commerciële inflow komt binnen via tenders en RFPs — en dat aandeel groeit. RFPs komen daarbij vaak van grotere enterprise-klanten en worden in samenwerking met andere Account Executives voorbereid en opgepakt.

Veel salesmensen begrijpen dat proces onvoldoende. Ze sturen standaardproposities en hopen op het beste. Wij geloven dat het anders moet: met echte gesprekken, diep begrip van aanbestedingsdynamiek en een adviseur die meedenkt in het PvE-proces in plaats van alleen reageert op een uitvraag.

Daarom bestaat deze rol. Jij bent onderdeel van het team aan tenderspecialisten die marktpartijen begeleidt van marktconsultatie tot tender tot win — en die daarna zorgt dat het contract goed landt.

Jouw rol


Je bouwt een sterke pijplijn van tenders en RFPs bij non-profitorganisaties, gemeenten, onderwijsinstellingen en enterprise-accounts. Je wint aanbestedingen en zorgt dat Studytube vanaf de marktconsultatie al als thought leader op de radar staat.

Concreet ga je aan de slag met:

  • Het vroegtijdig spotten van marktconsultaties (ism het Tenderteam) en het actief meedenken in het PvE-proces, zodat criteria aansluiten bij wat wij goed kunnen leveren.

  • Thought leadership richting inkopers en beleidsmakers, zodat Studytube al vóór de formele tender een bekende en vertrouwde naam is.

  • Het volledige tendertraject managen: van marktconsultatie, via inschrijving en EMVI-onderbouwing, tot gunning en win.

  • RFPs bij grotere enterprise-klanten samen met andere Account Executives voorbereiden en oppakken, zodat expertise en capaciteit gebundeld worden.

  • Het zorgvuldig managen van het contractproces na gunning, inclusief afstemming met legal over voorwaarden, aansprakelijkheid en SLA's.

  • Het opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met opleidingsmanagers, inkopers en directieleden bij non-profitorganisaties, gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen.

  • Het samenwerken met sales team, tenderteam, implementatieteam, contentteam en customer success team om klanten écht succesvol te maken.

What the job looks like

Geen strak jaarplan, maar een dynamische agenda die meebeweegt met de tenderkalender. De ene week werk je aan een marktconsultatie, de volgende week schrijf je aan een inschrijving, ondersteun je een collega-AE bij een enterprise-RFP, of onderhandel je over een contract.

Dagelijks ziet het er ongeveer zo uit:

  • Je volgt tenderplatforms en de markt scherp en identificeert kansen al in de marktconsultatiefase.

  • Je bouwt offertes en proposities die aansluiten bij EMVI-criteria en publieke waarden.

  • Je beoordeelt en onderhandelt contractvoorwaarden, en schakelt waar nodig met legal.

  • Je werkt samen met andere Account Executives aan RFPs voor grotere enterprise-klanten.

  • Je werkt samen met interne teams zodat de klant de beste ervaring krijgt – van tender tot implementatie.

  • Je monitort je pijplijn, stuurt bij en zorgt dat je targets realistisch maar ambitieus zijn.


Who you are

We zoeken geen standaard salesprofiel. We zoeken iemand die tenders en RFPs als vakgebied ziet, niet als bijzaak.

Wat wél belangrijk is:

  • Je hebt 4 tot 6 jaar ervaring in sales, bij voorkeur met tenders/RFPs in non-profit, overheid of onderwijs.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van marktconsultaties en het beïnvloeden van een PvE.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met contracten en legal processen — je bent niet bang voor voorwaarden, aansprakelijkheid en onderhandelingen (pre).

  • Je bent een consultative seller: je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en geeft oprecht advies.

  • Je bent relationeel sterk en bouwt liever langdurige partnerships dan snelle deals.

  • Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en kunt goed samenwerken met verschillende teams, ook binnen een enterprise-RFP waar je met andere AEs optrekt.

What we offer

  • Basis van €85K op basis van 40 uur per jaar, variabel €40K = totaal OTE €125k met goede secundaire voorwaarden

  • €1.000 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar + onbeperkt toegang tot de Studytube Academy

  • Flexibel werken en een inspirerend kantoor aan het IJ met eigen gym

  • MacBook, telefoonvergoeding en dagelijks verzorgde lunch

Over Studytube

Wij maken professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk, leuk en effectief. Met meer dan 300 klanten, waaronder veel non-profitorganisaties en bekende namen als Bol.com, ASR en Ajax, groeien we hard. Ons doel is duidelijk: Europa's beste platform voor leren en ontwikkelen worden.

Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product.

Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning. 

Wat je doet

  • Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten.

  • Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar.

  • Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors.

  • Je ruimt de architectuur op, maakt het platform uitbreidbaar en bouwt GDPR-bewust: toegang, retentie en verwijdering zitten in het ontwerp.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.

We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.

As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.
You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.
  • Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.
  • Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.
  • Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.
  • Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.
  • Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.
  • Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.

We expect you to have:

  • Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling.
  • A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.
  • Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.
  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.

We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.
Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure, GPU platforms, or large server fleets would be valuable.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful.
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Stage E-commerce & Influencer Marketing (NL/BE), fulltime, start januari/februari 2027
jobs.description:
Stage E-commerce & Influencer Marketing (NL/BE), fulltime, start januari/februari 2027

Wil je zien wat jouw ideeën doen voor een merk waar jonge ouders dol op zijn? Bij Petite Amélie zie je meteen het resultaat van je werk. Je zet bijvoorbeeld een samenwerking op met een Nederlandse influencer, of je bouwt een landingspagina voor een campagne, en je ziet direct wat het oplevert. Je haalt bij ons niet alleen koffie: vanaf dag één draai je volwaardig mee in ons marketing- & e-commerceteam, met de Nederlandse en Belgische markt als jouw terrein.

Over Petite Amélie

Wij ontwerpen en produceren meubels, accessoires en speelgoed voor baby- en kinderkamers, en jonge ouders in heel Europa zijn er dol op. We groeien snel, met webshops in Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Vanuit ons kantoor in Weesp (15 minuten met de trein vanaf Amsterdam Centraal) werken we met zo’n 30 collega’s aan het merk.

Wat ga je doen?

Ons team beheert de webshops en alle online kanalen. Organische groei en sterke content staan centraal. Je kiest samen met je begeleider waar je de nadruk op legt, op basis van je leerdoelen en interesses:

  • Influencers & samenwerkingen: je zoekt passende influencers en contentmakers in Nederland en België en neemt zelf contact met ze op. Je zet samenwerkingen op, zoals productgifting, contentdeals en campagnes, en je onderhoudt de relaties.

  • Content & social: je maakt content voor Instagram, TikTok en Pinterest en doet community management.

  • Campagnes & landingspagina’s: je helpt campagnes uitvoeren en bouwt en werkt aan pagina’s die converteren.

  • Webshop & merchandising: je bepaalt mee hoe producten in de shop worden gepresenteerd.

  • SEO & CRO: je zoekt uit waarom bezoekers wel of niet kopen, en wat we daaraan kunnen verbeteren.

  • Data & onderzoek: je rapporteert over e-commerce-KPI’s en doet marktonderzoek naar nieuwe kansen.

Aan het eind van je stage heb je echte resultaten en een eigen netwerk om te laten zien, en daarmee val je bij je volgende werkgever meteen op.

Wie zoeken we?

Dit heb je echt nodig:

  • Je studeert bedrijfskunde, marketing, communicatie, economie of iets vergelijkbaars, op hbo- of wo-niveau, en je stage is onderdeel van je opleiding (met stageovereenkomst).

  • Je bent fulltime beschikbaar voor minimaal 6 maanden, vanaf januari of februari 2027.

  • Je woont in Nederland.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed.

Dit maakt je een goede match:

  • Je pakt dingen zelf op, bent nieuwsgierig en denkt commercieel.

  • Je vindt het leuk om mensen te benaderen en relaties op te bouwen.

  • Je hebt oog voor design, interieur en esthetiek.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en graag samen.

Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt? Solliciteer toch. Enthousiasme en leergierigheid wegen voor ons zwaar.

Benefits

Dit bieden wij:

  • Een stagevergoeding van €650 per maand

  • Een OV-reisproduct of reiskostenvergoeding, en een laptop van de zaak

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van een vaste begeleider uit het team

  • Praktijkervaring in de hele e-commerce-mix: influencer marketing, social, community management, merchandising, webshopbeheer, analytics, SEO en CRO

  • Een warm, enthousiast team waarin je werk echt impact heeft, en waar we successen graag samen vieren

Klaar om ons te komen versterken?

Stuur je CV en vertel ons kort wie je bent. Je kunt een motivatie schrijven, maar je mag jezelf ook voorstellen met een reel, story of een ander creatief format. Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht.

Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. Daarna volgt een (video)kennismaking met je toekomstige begeleider, en je hoort snel of je in januari of februari kunt starten.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager

Junior Product Manager

Introductie

Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?

Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.

We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring.

In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.

Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.

  • Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

  • Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

  • Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

  • Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

  • Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

  • Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

  • Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

  • Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

  • Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

  • Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

  • Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

  • Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving

Wat bieden wij

Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring

  • 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen)

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro

  • Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement

  • De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio

  • Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams

  • Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Over FAAC Technologie

FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group, is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan.

De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen, met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units. Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.


Wie ben jij

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting.

  • Aan het begin van de carrière, met de ambitie om verder te groeien binnen productmanagement.

  • Affiniteit met technische producten en commerciële vraagstukken.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat breng je mee

  • Een analytische en nieuwsgierige instelling.

  • Goede organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Het vermogen om informatie te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en acties.

jobs.description:
Analytics Engineer – Client Reporting

Studytube makes professional development accessible. Our customers use client reporting, the insights they see in the platform, to understand how their people learn and to show the impact of their learning programmes. Those numbers have to be right, every time.

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer dedicated to client reporting. You build and maintain the dbt models and Looker reports behind it. Over the coming year we are moving from Snowflake to Databricks, and you help bring client reporting to the new platform.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain the dbt models behind client reporting, following our layered structure from source to report.

  • Develop Looker reporting end to end: LookML views and explores, dashboards embedded in our platform, and the client-specific logic behind them.

  • Turn client and Customer Success requests into reports, and push back when a definition or requirement is unclear.

  • Keep client reporting reliable: tests, monitoring, documentation, code review and CI as the standard.

  • Protect client data: access per client, privacy and GDPR built into every model and report.

  • Work with our data engineer on the ingestion syncs (today Fivetran) that feed client reporting.

  • Help migrate client reporting models from Snowflake to Databricks, including clients with specific data residency needs.

  • Align client metrics with the shared definitions in our central data foundation, so customers and internal teams see the same numbers.

Your team

You join the Client Reporting team, where client reporting is your full-time focus. The team includes a Product Manager, a dedicated QA engineer and another analytics engineer.

You work closely with the Product department, Customer Success and our central data team, so client reporting fits the product and answers what our customers need.


Who you are

You have 2 to 5 years of experience in analytics engineering or BI development, or grew into it from analysis or data engineering. You think in models and definitions before dashboards. You know that a number a customer sees has to be explainable, consistent and correct. If a client or a CS colleague cannot understand or trust a report, the work is not done.

Must-haves

  • Advanced SQL that is readable and reviewable.

  • dbt in production: macros, tests, documentation and environments.

  • Looker, including LookML: views, explores and dashboards.

  • Data modelling: dimensional, incremental, slowly changing dimensions.

  • A cloud data platform: Snowflake, Databricks or BigQuery.

  • Git workflows: pull requests, code review and CI.

  • Professional English.

Nice to have

Our stack

jobs.description:
Customer Success Engineer, Singapore

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Engineer, you'll expand your impact by partnering with customers in GitLab's group across APJ to help them get measurable value from GitLab through hands-on technical guidance and proactive enablement. You'll serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering with customers over Zoom and email to improve adoption, unblock implementations, and apply DevSecOps best practices across the software delivery lifecycle. Working closely with Account Executives and Renewals Managers, you'll align technical recommendations to customer goals and help support renewals and expansion by demonstrating outcomes. You'll also contribute back to the broader GitLab team by sharing learnings through documentation and enablement content, while mentoring team members and customers through complex technical challenges. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, communicates clearly, and thrives in a remote, asynchronous environment. You're eager to grow into customer-facing technical leadership with strong mentorship and support from a collaborative team.

What you’ll do

  • Provide on-demand technical consultancy and solution guidance through Zoom and written channels, helping customers solve day-to-day issues and design and implement GitLab solutions for their DevSecOps workflows.
  • Drive product adoption and measurable customer value across APJ accounts to support renewals and expansion.
  • Deliver technical and architectural guidance across source code management, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and Agile planning to unblock implementations and improve adoption.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Renewals Managers to align technical recommendations to customer objectives and account plans that support retention and growth.
  • Plan and lead customer workshops, demos, and enablement sessions that help teams adopt GitLab confidently and drive measurable adoption and value, supporting renewals and expansion across APJ.
  • Maintain and grow your specialty competency in GitLab capabilities and relevant DevSecOps tooling, staying current on new product features and patterns.
  • Contribute to scalable enablement by improving documentation, sharing knowledge through internal and external channels (for example, tutorials or technical content), and mentoring team members and customers to build technical competency and adoption.

What you’ll bring

In this role, you'll support our customers across APJ, delivering workshops, demos, and best-practice guidance while contributing back to our shared documentation and enablement resources. For more on how we work, see Customer Success Engineering team handbook page.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
jobs.description:
HR Business Partner, EMEA

Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby. I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success.

We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward.

Role overview:
We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you.

As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team.

Role requirements:

  • UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates.

  • Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place.

  • People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit.

  • Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint.

  • Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies

  • Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently.

  • Compensation Expertise: You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions.

  • Performance Management: You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles.

  • Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees.

  • Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company

  • 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations

  • 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries

  • 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through

  • 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change

  • 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development

  • 🔄 You are flexible in your approach and avoid rigid adherence to past playbooks or overly process-heavy solutions.

  • ⚡️ You're energized by a fast-paced environment with a mix of strategic and hands-on work

  • 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths

  • ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation

  • 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence

Bonus points if you have:

  • An advanced degree in HR, business, or organizational development

  • CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification

This role may not be a fit if:

  • You’re looking to simply bring processes or programs from previous roles and implement them here. While past experience is valuable, you'll need to apply principled thinking to assess what would work well for Ashby.

  • Working independently feels uncomfortable and you require a significant amount of guidance in how to perform your job.

  • Having difficult conversations with all levels of employees makes you uneasy

  • You shy away from ambiguity - preferring structured, pre-defined assignments.

  • You prefer working with a single team instead of multiple teams.

Interview process
Our interview process is thorough. We want to make sure everyone who joins is the right fit for Ashby, and we'll give you plenty of information to decide whether Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is:

  • Recruiter screen with the Talent Acquisition team (30 minutes)

  • People Ops team interview (45 minutes)

  • Take-home assignment (1 hour)

  • People Leader interview (45 minutes)

  • Virtual onsite (2–3 hours)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby -do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited holiday with five weeks recommended per year on top of UK bank holidays. Expect "Holiday?" on our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A generous budget for equipment, software, and office furniture. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • Top-notch supplemental health insurance (private medical and dental) for you and your dependents, with premiums covered by us, plus company-paid life insurance + income protection, and a workplace pension with a 3% Ashby contribution.

  • Generous family leave. You'll get your full statutory family leave entitlement, and Ashby pays the first 12 weeks at 100%.

  • £100/month education budget, with bigger items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby's success depends on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We're being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Full-Time UK

jobs.title: Paid Media & Performance Marketing Manager (B2B) - 4 Day Week + Remote
jobs.description:
Paid Media & Performance Marketing Manager (B2B) - 4 Day Week + Remote

If you're the kind of marketer who'd rather be in Google Ads than in a meeting about Google Ads, read on.

We have a full production team: content, design, web, video, product marketing. We have a sales team that wants more meetings and an SDR team that follows up fast. We have budget, and it's going up. What we don't have is the person who runs paid. Someone who builds the campaigns, reads the search terms, sets the bids, fixes the tracking, and turns the spend into booked demos.

That's this role. It's hands-on by design. There's no agency and no paid media team behind you, because we'd rather give the budget to the person doing the work. You own the number, 30 booked demos a month, and you own how you get there. About three quarters of your week is advertising. The rest is trade media, syndication and other digital lead gen.

We're looking for someone who's done this before, more than once, and has the numbers to show it.

Read on!

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

_________________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined.

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has:

  • Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that:

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions:

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

Shape helps main contractors build a stronger change case from site records. Our buyers are project managers and commercial managers at main contractors in the UK, US and Europe. Most of them aren't searching for a product like ours, because they don't know the problem has a fix. Your job is to find them, get them to a demo, and hand them to sales in good shape.

You own one number: 30 booked demos a month for the sales team. You own every digital lead generation activity that feeds it, and you run those activities yourself.

Team

You'll sit in Shape's marketing team and report to the Head of Marketing, who has a paid media background and has built most of our marketing automation in n8n and Claude. You'll work daily with the SDR team, who qualify and follow up what you generate, and the account executives who run the demos.

Content, design, web, video and product marketing are covered by the team. You brief them for ad creative, landing pages and lead magnets. You don't write the copy or design the assets. You do build and run everything in the ad platforms and in HubSpot.

You won't have an agency or a paid media team behind you. The budget goes into the channels, and you run them. You will have a Head of Marketing who's done this job, a production team to brief, and SDRs who want what you generate.

How your time splits

Full-funnel digital advertising

75%

Google Search, LinkedIn, Meta and any other platform that works for B2B. Cold acquisition, retargeting, free app sign-ups, demo requests. You build it, run it, optimise it and report on it.

Other digital lead generation

25%

Trade media advertising, content syndication, review sites, partnerships and anything else that produces demos at an acceptable cost. You'll test, measure and scale or cut.

Webinars sit alongside this. You'll promote them and fill the room through paid and the database. The programme itself is run by product marketing with speakers from sales.

What a normal week looks like

We work four-day weeks, Monday to Thursday. This is what yours would contain.

Every day

  • Log into Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Check spend, search terms, cost per lead, conversion volume. Add negatives, adjust bids and budgets, pause what isn't working.
  • Review every new lead in HubSpot. Check it has a source, check it against the ICP, make sure it's reached an SDR.
  • Chase any lead that's past the follow-up SLA. The SDRs are good, but you own the handoff until the demo is booked.

Every week

  • Launch or refresh at least one creative or landing page test.
  • Update the cost per demo by channel dashboard and share it with the Head of Marketing and sales.
  • A 30-minute sync with the SDR team on lead quality: what's converting, what isn't, and why.
  • Brief content and design on what you need next.

Every month

  • Reallocate budget across channels based on cost per booked demo.
  • Report on leads, demos booked, demos sat, cost per channel and what you're changing next month.
  • Launch or review a trade media or syndication test. Promote any webinar the team is running.

Every quarter

  • Prepare and present the channel strategy for the next quarter, with the numbers to back it.

Your first four weeks

  • Tracking fixed. UTMs on everything, deal source mandatory in HubSpot, lifecycle stages agreed with the SDRs, conversions firing in Google and LinkedIn.
  • Google Search and LinkedIn campaigns live and optimising.
  • A first read on what each channel costs per booked demo.

After that it's scaling what works and cutting what doesn't.

Your Capabilities

You are an operator. You've built and run B2B paid campaigns yourself, at more than one company, and you have the numbers to prove it. You think in cost per booked demo, not clicks. You'd rather bring a playbook you've already proven than experiment your way into one on our budget.

You are an expert in

  • Google Ads for B2B. Campaign and ad group structure, match types, negative keyword discipline, bid strategies and when to use each, conversion tracking, search term review, landing page alignment.
  • LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Matched audiences and account lists, job title and company targeting, retargeting from website, video and engagement, lead gen forms versus landing pages, document and video ads, the Insight Tag.
  • Retargeting across platforms including Meta, to warm audiences who already know us: website visitors, free app sign-ups, content downloaders, webinar registrants.
  • Conversion tracking and attribution. UTMs, Google Tag Manager, offline conversion uploads, getting source data onto CRM records so every demo can be traced to a channel.
  • HubSpot for marketing: forms, lifecycle stages, workflows, lead routing, reporting and the ads integration.
  • Landing page conversion. What to test, how to read the results, when to call it.
  • Reporting. Building a cost per demo by channel view that a Head of Marketing and a CEO can read without you explaining it.

You will have (The fundamentals)

  • Mastery: A repeatable B2B paid acquisition playbook you've run at more than one company, with numbers from both. Hands-on day to day in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager within the last 12 months. You personally built the campaigns, not a team, agency or specialist. You can state the largest monthly budget you've personally run, what a lead cost and what a booked meeting cost.
  • Communication: Fluent written and spoken English. Able to brief a creative team clearly and to report honestly upward on what's working and what isn't, including what you'd stop.
  • Leadership: You own a number and want to be measured on it. You work out why something isn't converting and fix the right problem. You lead yourself in a remote role without needing structure imposed on you.
  • Impact: AI-native. You use AI (we run on Claude) for reporting, analysis and admin so your time goes on the accounts and the strategy. If you're still doing manually what an AI can do, this isn't the role for you.

You will learn here (If you don't have it now you will after joining)

  • Trade media advertising and content syndication in a niche B2B market, and how to make bought leads convert.
  • Filling a webinar through paid and the database. A bonus if you've run webinars end to end.
  • Construction and how main contractors buy. A bonus, not a requirement.
  • n8n, for the automations that sit around your campaigns.

What we'll ask you about

So you can prepare, these are the things we'll want to talk through:

  • The largest monthly ad budget you've personally managed, on which platforms, and what a lead and a booked meeting cost you.
  • One B2B campaign you built yourself, from setting up the account to the meetings it produced, with the numbers at each stage.
  • Who else worked on your campaigns in your last role, and what they did versus what you did.
  • Which bid strategies you've used, in which situations, and why.
  • How you set up conversion tracking and attribution yourself, and in which tools.
  • At the second stage, a short exercise: the advertising plan you'd run to get us to 30 booked demos a month, presented back to us.

Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You'd rather set the strategy and have someone else build the campaigns
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on booked demos
  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this really hands-on, or is "hands-on" just a word in the ad? It's really hands-on. You'll be in the platforms every working day, and that's the point. If you've been managing people who do this and you miss doing it yourself, this is the role. If you'd rather keep managing, it probably isn't.

Can you tell me more about what the role is like? We are in scale up mode so it will be a full-on role with more things to do than time available. This is why it will be important to prioritise ruthlessly. The role is unusually clear about what success means, because it comes down to one number. That's a good thing if you like owning an outcome and having the autonomy to decide how you hit it.

What does success look like? Within four weeks: tracking fixed, campaigns live, a first view of cost per demo by channel. Within three months: a predictable flow of demos landing with sales, with cost per booked demo visible for every channel, and a clear path to 30 a month. Beyond that: trade media and syndication contributing so we're not dependent on ad spend alone.

What have you already got in place? Budget. A full production team for content, design, web and video. HubSpot as CRM and marketing platform, shared with sales. A free app with a two-month trial that already produces sign-ups. A hungry SDR team and account executives who want more inbound. A Head of Marketing who has done this job before and will work alongside you on strategy, while you run the execution.

Where would I be working? All our roles are 100% remote and home-based. However, if you would like to work in a co-work space to get out of the house we may be able to arrange that. If you are in one of our locations with offices, you can come as often as you like.

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

  • Why do you want to join us?
  • The largest monthly ad budget you have personally managed, on which platforms, and what a lead and a booked meeting cost
  • One B2B paid campaign you built yourself, and the numbers it produced

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all letters will be read thoroughly.

After that, we will reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

After that, we will schedule a couple of technical and personal assessments to understand what your level of capability is based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join you are starting at the right level of responsibility based on your capability not just based on experience.

Compensation

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer, ML Inference
jobs.description:
Backend Software Engineer, ML Inference

Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the role

You will have ownership over designing, building, and scaling the core systems that bring Prior Labs' foundation models to the world. This is a unique opportunity to make fundamental architectural decisions, establish engineering best practices from the ground up, and profoundly shape the technical direction for serving state-of-the-art AI.

TabPFN does its learning in the forward pass, and it now handles datasets in the millions of rows. Making that fast, reliable, and affordable is an exciting engineering challenge.

You'll work directly with world-class AI researchers, translating cutting-edge models into scalable production systems. This role offers significant autonomy and impact, with clear paths to specialize in areas you're passionate about (like inference optimization and core backend systems) or grow into a technical leadership position as our team expands. You won't just be implementing features; you'll be building the backbone of our company.

What you'll work on:

  • Own Inference: Own the serving path end-to-end: latency, throughput, batching, memory behavior on large inputs, and cost per prediction. Our models serve through our managed API, inside customer VPCs, and as self-hosted open weights, and you’ll have an impact across the board.

  • Architect & Design: Design robust, scalable, and secure backend systems and production-grade APIs for serving our foundation models.

  • Build & Implement: Develop high-quality, maintainable code for core backend services.

  • Own Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and manage core infrastructure on cloud platforms, focusing on reliability, monitoring, observability, and cost-efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance & Security: Implement secure, GDPR-compliant systems, including data storage, access control, usage tracking, and quota management.

  • Champion Best Practices: Drive high standards for testing, CI/CD, documentation, and security within the engineering team.

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning and backend engineering, with a proven track record of managing production infrastructure.

  • Proven experience deploying and operating machine learning models in production, with a strong understanding of how models behave and fail under real traffic.

  • Strong, hands-on experience designing and building production-grade APIs and backend services.

  • Significant experience building and operating services on cloud platforms, with GCP preferred.

  • Strong, hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform.

  • Significant experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Proficiency in Python.

What sets you apart

  • Experience building or managing infrastructure specifically for machine learning (MLOps, model serving frameworks, feature stores, data pipelines).

  • Deep experience with inference optimization (quantization, compilation, dynamic batching, caching strategies, interplay with distributed computing).

  • Experience with PyTorch and FastAPI specifically.

  • Contributions to relevant open-source projects.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

jobs.title: (Senior) Security Engineer - m/f/d
jobs.description:
(Senior) Security Engineer - m/f/d

Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

We’re hiring a hands-on (Senior) Security Engineer to strengthen the security of Langdock’s product, infrastructure, and internal systems.

Your primary focus will be application and infrastructure security. You’ll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to identify risks, assess our defenses, and drive practical improvements. You’ll coordinate penetration tests, triage incoming vulnerability reports, and make sure findings turn into lasting fixes. You should be comfortable getting into technical details, challenging assumptions, and helping engineers choose the right controls.

You’ll also own the security of our internal IT environment, including identity, access, and device security. We’re looking for someone who builds reliable, automated processes and can judge whether our protections are effective.

Alongside this technical work, you’ll help explain our security posture to customers and support our compliance efforts. The foundation of this role is making Langdock secure; audits and customer assessments should reflect that work.

What You Will Do

The role's responsibility will span over multiple fields, which are:

Application security

  • Coordinate penetration tests end to end. Define scope with engineering and external testing partners, support testing, assess findings, and follow remediation through to verification.

  • Own vulnerability intake and triage. Monitor our security inbox and responsible disclosure program, assess reported issues, and work with engineering to prioritize and resolve them.

  • Help engineering build securely. Review security-sensitive designs and changes, identify weaknesses in areas such as authentication, authorization, and data isolation, and recommend practical improvements.

Infrastructure security

  • Assess and improve our security posture. Work with engineering to evaluate how our production infrastructure and internal systems are protected, identify gaps, and drive improvements.

  • Strengthen network and access controls. Review network separation, service exposure, privileged access, and permissions so systems and data are accessible only where needed.

  • Verify that controls work in practice. Look beyond configuration checklists to understand how systems could be compromised and whether our protections would prevent or detect it.

Internal security and automation

  • Own identity and device security. Ensure we have effective MFA, appropriate access policies, and properly managed, encrypted, and patched devices.

  • Automate the employee lifecycle. Build dependable processes for account provisioning, access changes, offboarding, and access reviews across Entra ID and our internal tools.

  • Keep recurring work manageable. Use scripts, integrations, and AI tooling to automate security operations and surface issues that need attention.

Customer assurance and compliance

  • Support customer security assessments. Help answer questionnaires and join customer conversations that require a clear, technically credible explanation of our security controls.

  • Contribute to our compliance programs. Support our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II work through effective controls, current evidence, and technical input into audits and risk assessments.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • Hands-on application and infrastructure security experience. You understand how modern SaaS applications and cloud environments are built, where they can fail, and how to protect them.

  • Technical depth and sound judgment. You can investigate a vulnerability, assess its practical impact, discuss remediation with engineers, and distinguish urgent risks from lower-priority findings.

  • Experience taking findings through to resolution. You’ve worked with penetration testers or vulnerability disclosure programs and helped teams turn reports into verified fixes.

  • Confidence with identity and endpoint security. You’re comfortable configuring identity providers, MFA, access policies, and device management, and automating the processes around them.

  • An automation mindset. You build scripts, workflows, and integrations to reduce recurring work, and use AI tooling thoughtfully to increase your effectiveness.

  • Clear communication. You can explain technical risks and controls to engineers, colleagues, and customers. German is a plus, but not a requirement.

  • Pragmatism. You prioritize meaningful risk reduction and choose controls that teams can realistically implement and maintain.

Experience with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and customer security assessments is valuable. Your strongest skill set should be in technical security.

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.

About the job

As a Senior Product Engineer, you'll build the product our customers use every day: requirements formulation, document comparison, compliance checks against internal SOPs, and the AI agents that work alongside regulatory and quality experts.

Product thinking is as important here as engineering execution. You'll sit close to customers, product and design, figure out what actually needs to be built, and then build it end to end, from the data model and the backend workflow to the agent and the interface on top.

Because we operate in a highly regulated industry, correctness, traceability and reliability are central to how we build. A feature is done when it works for the customer, not when the ticket is closed.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

How you'll contribute

We are not looking for someone to just complete tickets. We want an engineer who owns outcomes, challenges assumptions and helps decide what we build.

  • Own product areas end to end. Take a workflow, such as document comparison or compliance checks, and own how well it works for customers: quality, reliability, speed and how it evolves.

  • Shape what gets built. Work with product and domain experts on discovery, challenge requirements, and turn fuzzy customer problems into clear, shippable slices.

  • Build across the stack. Design and ship features across React frontends, TypeScript services, durable workflows and PostgreSQL.

  • Make AI features trustworthy. Build LLM- and agent-driven features that regulatory experts can review, correct and rely on, with the guardrails, evaluation and traceability that requires.

  • Raise the bar. Review designs and code, share context, and help the team ship faster without lowering quality.

Our stack

We work in a modern TypeScript-first monorepo:

  • Core: Node.js, TypeScript, pnpm workspaces

  • Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, our own design system

  • Backend and workflows: Express-based services, DBOS for durable workflows

  • Data and storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma, Azure Blob Storage

  • AI: Azure OpenAI, agent frameworks such as Mastra and the Vercel AI SDK

  • Observability: Sentry, Datadog, OpenTelemetry

What you'll bring

  • Product judgement. You can talk to a user, understand the job they're trying to do, and push back when the requested feature isn't the right answer.

  • Solid data fundamentals: data modelling, migrations and query performance, ideally in PostgreSQL.

  • Experience building on LLMs or agents in production is a strong plus, especially where output quality has to be measured, reviewed or corrected.

  • A high quality bar and a pragmatic mindset. You ship maintainable, well-tested software and use AI tools as leverage without compromising reliability.

  • Ownership. You care whether the thing works for the customer, and you follow it into production.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have worked on B2B software for complex, document-heavy or regulated domains (MedTech, pharma, legal, finance or similar).

Why this is a great opportunity

  • Impact in a high-stakes domain. Your work helps medical devices and treatments reach patients faster and more safely.

  • Bring GenAI into production. Build AI features that regulated enterprises can trust and audit.
