jobs.description:
HR Business Partner, EMEA

Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby. I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success.

We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward.

Role overview:
We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you.

As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team.

Role requirements:

  • UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates.

  • Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place.

  • People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit.

  • Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint.

  • Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies

  • Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently.

  • Compensation Expertise: You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions.

  • Performance Management: You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles.

  • Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees.

  • Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company

  • 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations

  • 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries

  • 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through

  • 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change

  • 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development

  • 🔄 You are flexible in your approach and avoid rigid adherence to past playbooks or overly process-heavy solutions.

  • ⚡️ You're energized by a fast-paced environment with a mix of strategic and hands-on work

  • 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths

  • ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation

  • 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence

Bonus points if you have:

  • An advanced degree in HR, business, or organizational development

  • CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification

This role may not be a fit if:

  • You’re looking to simply bring processes or programs from previous roles and implement them here. While past experience is valuable, you'll need to apply principled thinking to assess what would work well for Ashby.

  • Working independently feels uncomfortable and you require a significant amount of guidance in how to perform your job.

  • Having difficult conversations with all levels of employees makes you uneasy

  • You shy away from ambiguity - preferring structured, pre-defined assignments.

  • You prefer working with a single team instead of multiple teams.

Interview process
Our interview process is thorough. We want to make sure everyone who joins is the right fit for Ashby, and we'll give you plenty of information to decide whether Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is:

  • Recruiter screen with the Talent Acquisition team (30 minutes)

  • People Ops team interview (45 minutes)

  • Take-home assignment (1 hour)

  • People Leader interview (45 minutes)

  • Virtual onsite (2–3 hours)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby -do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited holiday with five weeks recommended per year on top of UK bank holidays. Expect "Holiday?" on our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A generous budget for equipment, software, and office furniture. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • Top-notch supplemental health insurance (private medical and dental) for you and your dependents, with premiums covered by us, plus company-paid life insurance + income protection, and a workplace pension with a 3% Ashby contribution.

  • Generous family leave. You'll get your full statutory family leave entitlement, and Ashby pays the first 12 weeks at 100%.

  • £100/month education budget, with bigger items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby's success depends on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We're being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.description:
Developer Experience Engineer - AI SDLC

We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The role

You lead how Sparta builds software in the AI era. You own our AI-native software development lifecycle: the development agents engineers work alongside, the CI/CD that ships their code, and the testing strategy that lets us move fast without breaking trading workflows.

AI has changed how code gets written, reviewed, and tested, and the tooling has not caught up. Your job is to make an engineer with Claude Code, a good harness and a fast pipeline several times more effective, and to prove it with data, not anecdotes.

What you will do

  • Own the AI development toolchain. Set up and evolve Claude Code and other development agents across engineering: shared skills, MCP servers, repo context, and guardrails, so agents work well in our codebase out of the box.

  • Build agents into the lifecycle. Automate the work around the code: AI-assisted code review, test generation, dependency upgrades, migrations and incident triage, with humans in the loop where it matters.

  • Make CI/CD fast and boring. Own build, test and release pipelines across the Nx monorepo: caching, affected-only builds, preview environments and safe, frequent deploys to AWS.

  • Build the guardrails for everyone who builds. Anyone can build now, including product, design, data and domain experts working with agents. Create the tooling that makes it safe for them to contribute code: automated quality gates, code ownership and review rules, preview environments, policy checks and agent evals in the pipeline, so good changes ship fast and risky ones are caught early. Testing strategy sits inside this: define what we test at each level and make the right tests cheap to write.

  • Keep it secure. Secrets, permissions and sandboxing for agents that read code and run commands, and supply-chain checks in the pipeline.

  • Raise the bar for everyone. Run enablement, write the playbooks, pair with teams and turn good practice from one team into the default for all of engineering.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience as a hands-on software engineer, with recent focus on developer experience, platform or build and release engineering.

  • You have rolled out AI coding tools to a team and made them stick: you know where agents help, where they fail and how to set them up for a real codebase.

  • You lead without needing authority: you treat engineers as customers, listen first, and win adoption with tools people want to use.

Nice to have

  • Built Claude Code skills, plugins or MCP servers, or extended another agent harness.

  • Deep CI/CD experience: you have designed pipelines for a monorepo, cut build and test times, and run safe, frequent releases.

  • Infrastructure as code and container platforms.

  • Experience defining or running engineering metrics.

Our stack for this team

Claude Ecosystem · Nx monorepo · GitHub · AWS · TypeScript · Python · Kotlin

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Reporting to the Tax Director, you will manage the non-US compliance and indirect tax managers, own group provision delivery, and work closely with Finance and the US tax team.   • Lead tax data, systems and process improvements with Finance, establishing dependable inputs from accounting, procurement and other teams.

  • Coordinate non-US cash tax forecasts, payments and material VAT/GST recovery assumptions, feeding group forecasts with the US team.

  • Manage recurring adviser scopes and service quality, coordinate tax inputs to financial audits, and lead operational responses to non-US tax authority enquiries.

  • Ensure new entities, transactions and approved tax positions are incorporated into filings and reporting, working with the transaction and international tax teams.

  • Coordinate employment and equity tax obligations with People, Payroll, Legal and specialist advisers, with local responsibilities and escalation routes clearly assigned.

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Junior AI Engineer

Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

The product works, clients renew, and every month millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure before they buy. That traffic produces a unique dataset, and we want to get even more out of it: uncover the hidden patterns in how shoppers search, compare and decide, and use them to keep improving our recommendation algorithms and campaign performance.

As our Junior AI Engineer, this is applied work: you dig into the data, find what drives performance, ship the improvement to production and measure the result. You also maintain and improve our agents in production, and build the Claude Code skills that automate operational work and save time for the business team. You work directly with our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, alongside product and engineering.

Understand what drives performance

  • Explore our conversational and behavioural data, alongside campaign performance

  • Track our key metrics, spot what moves, and find out why

  • Surface the hidden patterns that make recommendations more relevant

Ship your findings to production

  • Turn your findings into improvements to our recommendation algorithms and agents, implemented in production

  • Measure the impact directly with A/B tests, and feed the results into the next iteration

  • Industrialise the analyses you run often into automated pipelines and monitoring, reviewed by the engineering team

Improve our agents in production

  • Maintain and improve our agents: prompts, tools, evaluation, and the code around them

  • Turn client feedback into agent improvements: qualify what they ask for, and ship directly what can be handled at the agent level

Automate operations at scale

  • Build and maintain Claude Code skills that automate operational work at scale and free up time for the business team

Profile

Must-have

  • 0 to 3 years of experience, internships and work-study included. Fresh graduates are welcome.

  • Personal projects where you built LLM agents end to end (prompts, tools, evaluation), or ran a serious data analysis on your own

  • Hands-on prompt engineering: you write, test and iterate on prompts, and you measure whether a change actually made things better

  • Solid SQL and Python for analysis

  • The basics of statistics: you know how to read an A/B test and when not to trust a number

  • You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) every day

  • Rigorous and precise: you check your numbers before you share them

  • Fluent French and professional English

A plus

  • A top engineering, business or data school, in France or abroad

  • AI courses or certifications

  • You have founded something, even small, and got real users or paying customers

  • Hackathons, open source, or side projects that went further than a weekend

  • TypeScript

  • Recommender systems, ranking or applied ML experience

  • E-commerce, advertising, growth or conversion experience

  • BigQuery, dbt, PostHog

What we offer

  • Competitive salary plus equity (BSPCE)

  • You learn next to our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, two of them repeat YC founders

  • A dataset very few people will ever see: 100M+ conversations a month between shoppers and AI agents

  • An AI-first team: Claude Code and agents are part of everyone's daily work

  • Ownership that grows fast: you start by taking real work off our plates, and take on more as you prove yourself

Merchant Risk Analyst

Build with us
Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.
With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.
We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.
Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

This is a high-impact role where you directly protect Mollie's financial stability and reputation. As an Merchant Risk Analyst, you are the first line of defense, proactively monitoring merchant activity to identify and mitigate patterns indicative of fraud or financial crime. This work is critical to safeguarding our platform integrity, ensuring our merchants and customers can trust Mollie as a secure and reliable payments provider.

You will be expected to conduct proactive and reactive fraud investigations, moving beyond simple alert validation to interpret complex fraud scenarios and uncover emerging risks. Your analysis and recommendations will directly shape cross-team decision-making across compliance, operations, and fraud strategy, positioning you as a trusted Subject Matter Expert.

If you are driven to continuously challenge existing practices, propose improvements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, and want to master the craft of financial crime analysis, you will be key to strengthening our overall risk resilience and staying ahead of evolving threats in the payments landscape.

What you'll ship

  • Detect and investigate fraud risks through proactive monitoring, deep data analysis, and event-driven reviews of merchant activity.

  • Mitigate financial losses by validating, escalating, and actioning fraud alerts promptly to protect platform integrity.

  • Deliver clear, actionable recommendations for mitigation strategies based on your interpretation of complex fraud scenarios and typologies.

  • Drive continuous process improvement by proactively proposing enhancements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, tools, and processes.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert, advising internal and external stakeholders on emerging fraud trends, typologies, and compliance standards.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience in fraud detection, investigations, or financial crime analysis.

  • Strong data analysis skills and the proven ability to interpret complex transaction patterns and identify anomalies.

  • Knowledge of payment systems, merchant risk, fraud typologies, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • Proficiency with fraud monitoring tools, case management systems, or relevant dashboards.

  • Clear and effective communication skills to articulate complex scenarios and mitigation strategies to cross-functional and external teams.

  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach that thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.

Base location for this role can be either Amsterdam or Maastricht.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
Cloud Architect

About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this."

You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute.

If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

  • Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory

  • Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit

  • Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages.

  • Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time

  • Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice

  • Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces


What You’ll Bring:

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows

  • Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production

  • Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for

  • A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration

  • Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications

  • Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure

  • Professional English; Dutch is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up

  • Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry

  • Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region)

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including a pension plan

  • 25 days of annual leave (full-time position)

  • A high-skilled team based in Utrecht

  • Frequent out-of-work team activities and an annual company weekend away

  • A training budget

  • The chance to help shape the new niche of autonomous medical robotics

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive

Studytube is een Nederlands SaaS-bedrijf. We bouwen een alles-in-één leerplatform (LMS en LXP) voor Learning & Development en HR. Als Enterprise Account Executive begeleid je organisaties met 1.000+ medewerkers naar een aankoopbeslissing. In het proces van oriëntatie, tot strategievorming, tot het daadwerkelijk ingaan van een inkooptraject ben jij de trusted partner. Je schakelt daarmee op meerdere niveaus inclusief C-niveau en met verschillende stakeholders intern en extern.

Je weet hoe een complex salestraject werkt. Er zijn meerdere beslissers, een inkoopafdeling die kritisch onderhandelt en een directie die wil weten wat de business case is. Juist dat trekt je aan. Bij Studytube krijg je de ruimte om grote organisaties te helpen impact te laten maken door hun mensen te ontwikkelen.

Waarom dit werk ertoe doet

Er worden miljarden uitgegeven aan opleidingen en organisaties investeren significant in opleiden. Toch mist meer dan de helft van de medewerkers nog steeds de skills die ze nodig hebben. Skills veranderen sneller dan functies kunnen bijhouden en voor organisaties zijn juist die nieuwe skills cruciaal. Studytube brengt dat samen in één leerplatform. Het platform maakt skill gaps zichtbaar en stemt leren af op de strategie van de organisatie. Jij voert dat gesprek met de mensen die erover beslissen en Studytube ontwikkelt door vanuit een heldere missie: "maak leren voor iedereen persoonlijk”. Je zult begrijpen dat AI op vele manieren verweven is met onze leerinfrastructuur en vanuit onze Innovatie Hub investeren we hier fors in.


Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de acquisitie van enterprise-accounts in de Benelux en sectoren als bouw & installatie, retail, staffing en facilities. Je doel is nieuwe logo’s binnenhalen met een gemiddelde dealgrootte van €6k MRR. Je regisseert het hele traject, van het eerste gesprek met de CHRO tot het getekende contract. Je wordt beoordeeld op één ding: nieuwe business die blijft en groeit.

  • Je opent deuren op directieniveau en bouwt een businesscase die overeind blijft bij de CFO en bij Inkoop.

  • Je stuurt de deal teams aan: Solution Engineering, Legal, Security en Delivery. Zij leveren, jij houdt de regie.

  • Je forecast scherp, en een commit is bij jou ook echt een commit.

Wat jij meebrengt

  • 7 jaar of meer ervaring in B2B-sales, waarvan minimaal 4 jaar als Enterprise AE in SaaS.

  • Je hebt je target meerdere jaren achter elkaar behaald of overtroffen, en je laat de cijfers graag zien.

  • Je sluit deals van tussen de €50k - €200k ARR, met cycli van 6 tot 12 maanden en een brede groep beslissers.

  • Je beheerst MEDDICC of Challenger zo goed dat je er anderen in kunt coachen.

  • Ervaring in HR-tech of L&D is een pré, maar geen vereiste.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een goed salaris. OTE van €140k - €160k, variabel zonder plafond en met accelerators boven 100%.

  • Een warm portfolio met bestaande relaties en ook een open gebied ondersteund door DemandGen, een SDR team, een Bid Team en Solution Engineer.

  • Een product dat de vraagstukken van grote organisaties oplost: skills, AI en persoonlijk leren.

  • Directe lijnen naar het MT en ruimte om mee te bouwen aan hoe enterprise-sales bij Studytube werkt.

  • Een echt groeipad. We werken in PODs, en voor de juiste persoon is POD Lead een logische volgende stap.

  • Flexibiliteit. Jij bepaalt waar en wanneer je het beste werk levert. Je combineert thuiswerken met 3 dagen op kantoor en deelt je agenda in zoals het bij jouw leven past. Wil je ’s ochtends een klant bezoeken en ’s middags de kinderen uit school halen? Dat kan gewoon. We sturen op resultaat, niet op aanwezigheid.

  • Een kantoor waar je graag bent. Er is een eigen gym en we verzorgen de lunches. Daarnaast zijn er teamuitjes en bijeenkomsten om successen samen te vieren.

Over Studytube

Studytube begon in 2011 bij twee rechtenstudenten. Ze bouwden een studietool voor zichzelf en ontdekten hoeveel beter mensen leren als het leren op hén is afgestemd. Dat inzicht is nog steeds de kern van wat we doen. Onze missie is het volledige potentieel van mensen ontsluiten met persoonlijk leren, op grote schaal.

Ons leerplatform combineert een LMS, een leeromgeving met AI-aanbevelingen, een Skill Navigator en een marketplace met meer dan 1.000 opleiders. Meer dan 700+ organisaties werken met Studytube, van 50 tot 30.000 medewerkers. Daaronder zijn bol, a.s.r., CZ, ManpowerGroup en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s werken we aan één doel: het platform voor professionele ontwikkeling worden waar Europa op vertrouwt.

jobs.title: Stagiair Volkskrant
jobs.description:
Stagiair Volkskrant

Amsterdam - Bij de Volkskrant zijn het hele jaar door op alle deelredacties stagiairs welkom. Journalistiek talent bieden wij een leuke en leerzame periode, van minimaal drie maanden.

Tijdens je stage krijg je volop kansen om in een plezierige werksfeer zelf aan de slag te gaan. Je draait volledig mee op een deelredactie: je schrijft artikelen, helpt mee bij audiovisuele producties of doet ander werk binnen onze journalistieke organisatie.

Deze vacature is bedoeld voor stageplekken van maart tot en met mei 2027. Stuur je sollicitatie voor deze periode uiterlijk woensdag 16 december 2026 in. De weken daarna gebruiken wij voor de selectie van stagiairs. Voor latere stageperiodes kun je al wel solliciteren, maar over de invulling van die plekken nemen we pas later een besluit.

Solliciteren?
Dat kan via de button op de website. Om een goed te kunnen beoordelen of een stage bij de Volkskrant bij je past, vragen we je om het volgende aan te leveren:

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Motivatiebrief

  • Drie Nederlandstalige artikelen of producties van jouw hand. De artikelen of producties hoeven niet daadwerkelijk gepubliceerd te zijn. Voeg deze artikelen integraal of via een url toe onderaan je motivatiebrief.

  • Vergeet niet te vermelden op welke redacties je zou willen werken en in welke periode.


We bieden stages aan op de volgende deelredacties:

  • Binnenland: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, reportages, interviews of korte analyses over het nieuws uit Nederland.

  • Politieke redactie (in Den Haag): je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten en debatverslagen over de landelijke politiek.

  • Buitenland: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, interviews, profielen of korte analyses over het nieuws uit andere landen.

  • Economie: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, reportages, interviews of korte analyses over het economisch nieuws uit binnen- en buitenland.

  • Wetenschap: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, analyses of interviews over het nieuws uit de wetenschappelijke wereld.

  • Data-, osint- en onderzoeksjournalistiek: je schrijft artikelen op basis van data of andere openbare bronnen of werkt mee aan langlopende onderzoeken.

  • V (kunst, cultuur en media): je schrijft nieuwsberichten, analyses, interviews of reportages over het nieuws uit de culturele wereld in binnen- en buitenland.

  • Sport: je schrijft nieuwsberichten, analyses, interviews of reportages over het nieuws uit de sportwereld.

  • Visuele redactie: je helpt en denkt mee aan de productie van onderscheidende online verhalen, waarbij tekst samengaat met foto, video en andere verhaalelementen.

  • Video, audio en event: je helpt en denkt mee bij de productie van onze podcasts, video’s en bij de organisatie van live-evenementen van de Volkskrant.

  • Foto / beeldredactie: je helpt en denkt mee bij de keuze van foto’s bij onze nieuwsartikelen en andere verhalen.

  • Digitaal team: je helpt en denkt mee bij de verspreiding van onze artikelen via de mobiele app, website, nieuwsbrieven en pushberichten.


Wat maakt jou een goede kandidaat?

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, hebt journalistieke ambitie en affiniteit met de Volkskrant.

  • Voor de verslaggevende redacties: je hebt schrijftalent en -ervaring.

  • Je bent gewend om zelfstandig te werken.

  • Je bent minimaal drie maanden fulltime beschikbaar. Een vierdaagse werkweek is bespreekbaar.

We hebben een voorkeur voor studenten van een hbo-opleiding of een master journalistiek, maar ook anderen zijn van harte welkom om te solliciteren. De Volkskrant streeft een diverse redactie na: we nodigen stagiairs met een biculturele achtergrond nadrukkelijk uit werkervaring bij ons op te doen.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een leuke en leerzame periode bij de grootste kwaliteitskrant van Nederland.

  • Intensieve begeleiding door je chef en ervaren redacteuren. 

  • De stage duurt in principe drie maanden. Een verlenging is tijdens je stage bespreekbaar.

  • Een stagevergoeding van 400 euro per maand (exclusief een reiskostenvergoeding).

  • Een abonnement op de Volkskrant gedurende je stageperiode.


Vragen?
Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met stagecoördinator Pepijn de Lange via het e-mailadres .

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer (Australia, Remote)
jobs.description:
Site Reliability Engineer (Australia, Remote)

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a contributor in the SRE organization, you are passionate about delivering solutions to the real-time problems our mission-critical cloud native services encounter. You are also obsessed about achieving the high quality and reliability our customers demand. You will work closely not only with the SRE division, but your technical deliverables will reach the entire engineering organization to enable product teams to continuously deliver features on the vanguard of innovation.

What You'll Do

Location: Remote anywhere in Australia

  • Contribute to building and maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure cloud platforms and tools.
  • Apply site reliability engineering principles to improve system stability and performance.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues in distributed cloud-native systems.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to support service reliability and operational excellence.
  • Create and maintain documentation to support engineers and improve self-service capabilities.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, learning best practices along the way.
  • Continuously develop your skills and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

What You Bring

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in software engineering, SRE, or infrastructure roles
  • Solid understanding of operating systems, preferably Linux
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or similar
  • Experience with Kubernetes platforms like AKS, EKS, or similar
  • Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, Go, C#, Java, or similar
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation practices
  • Experience with observability tools (logging, metrics, APM)
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code concepts (e.g., Terraform, ARM, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Australian government security clearance, or ability to obtain clearance (AUS citizenship) required

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus and Restricted Stock Unit Eligibility
  • Attractive Paid Time Off
  • Monthly Stipend for Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave for All Employees
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness Support
  • Learning & Development Programs

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com. Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

jobs.description:
Associate Customer Account Manager

Employ is transforming how hiring gets done. With our three ATS solutions - Jobvite, Lever, and JazzHR - plus cutting-edge AI Companions, we free recruiters from admin work and give them more time for what matters: connecting with people. More than 26,000 global customers rely on Employ to make millions of candidate connections each year, helping them hire smarter, faster, and at scale. From growing startups to the world’s most recognized brands, we’re redefining what’s possible in talent acquisition.

We’re a fast-moving, remote-first team of builders and innovators who live our people-first philosophy every day. We back it up with flexible work scheduling and paid time off, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities that help you thrive. At Employ, you won’t just grow your career - you’ll help millions of others grow theirs.

Come join our team where we have each other’s backs, champion our customers, hold ourselves accountable, and shape what’s next in talent acquisition.

Candidate Safety Notice

Please note, employ takes candidate safety seriously. Employ recruiters and employees communicate only via official @employinc.com email addresses. We will never request payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from Employ, please report it to security@employinc.com.

About the Opportunity:

This is a high-impact opportunity to grow your career as a SaaS seller and trusted customer advisor. As an Associate Customer Account Manager (CAM), you will drive expansion revenue within our existing customer base by deepening relationships, uncovering upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and helping customers get more value from their investment. In this hybrid role, you'll own expansion opportunities across an assigned portfolio of SMB low-touch customers while also supporting experienced CAMs with lead identification, qualification, and outreach within high-touch accounts. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, high-activity environment, with direct exposure to experienced CAMs and real deal cycles.

About the Team:

You’ll be part of a high-energy, remote-first Customer Account Management team focused on growing the value our customers see from Employ. The team values accountability, continuous improvement, and shared success. CAMs work closely with CX, Security, Finance, and Legal, so collaboration across teams is a core part of the job. You’ll receive strong coaching through regular 1:1s and Gong call reviews, along with exposure to top-performing sellers across the customer base.

We hold ourselves to clear standards: consistent daily call activity, a steady cadence of weekly customer meetings, prompt lead response, accurate forecasting, and clean Salesforce data. In return, you’ll get the training, product enablement, and mentorship to hit your expansion targets and build a long-term career in sales.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own expansion opportunities across an assigned portfolio of existing low-touch customers, managing the sales process from initial outreach through close.

  • Partner with high-touch CAMs to identify and qualify expansion opportunities, supporting account outreach and relationship development.

  • Place a consistent volume of outbound calls and run personalized outreach cadences to establish relationships, uncover needs, and surface upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

  • Support high-touch outreach by building relationships across multiple stakeholders within an account, so expansion conversations never depend on a single contact.

  • Prepare for every touch with a point of view on what the customer isn’t using yet and why it matters, drawing on usage data, account history, and prior notes.

  • Lead customer meetings and conceptual product walkthroughs that connect Employ products to each customer’s goals, business outcomes, and ROI.

  • Partner with CX on renewals, leading the expansion conversation within the renewal.

  • Follow up on leads promptly and with sound judgment.

  • Keep Salesforce accurate and up to date with proper notes and updates, and contribute to the Weekly Expansion Forecast Meeting.

  • Consult on RFPs as needed, working across teams to deliver accurate, on-time responses.

  • Continuously develop your sales skills through coaching, call review, enablement sessions, and deal exposure.

What You Bring:

  • 2–3 years of proven success in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or SDR/BDR roles (upsell, cross-sell, or closing experience preferred).

  • Experience selling SaaS or HR technology solutions.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Highspot, or ZoomInfo.

  • Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and personalized outreach to existing customers.

  • Ability to build relationships and multi-thread across stakeholders within an account.

  • Ability to connect product capabilities to a customer’s goals, business outcomes, and ROI.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the discipline to keep Salesforce updated with proper notes and updates.

  • Resilience and the ability to handle rejection while maintaining performance.

  • Coachability and a willingness to apply feedback quickly.

  • Curiosity about our products and a commitment to staying current on releases and the roadmap.

  • A collaborative, responsive working style with internal teams such as CX, Security, Finance, and Legal.

  • A competitive mindset focused on achieving and exceeding quota.

  • Strong motivation to build a long-term career in sales.

  • Clear and confident communication skills.

Compensation

We believe clarity builds trust, so we share the national pay range for this role: $55,641– $65,000 per year (USD base salary). This range reflects the scope of the role across the U.S. and is informed by market data, internal equity, and the responsibilities of the position.

Your final offer will consider your unique skills, experience, and location. In addition to base salary, total compensation may include performance bonuses, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

If you’d like more details about how compensation is determined or how benefits factor in, please get in touch. We’re committed to fair, transparent pay and want to make sure you have the information you need.

Additional Information

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how thousands of employees experience total rewards at Employ — ensuring programs that attract, engage, and retain top talent across the globe.

Meaningful, mission-driven work: Join a team where operational excellence in HR directly supports Employ’s mission to improve hiring outcomes for both people and businesses.

Remote-first culture: Work from where you’re most productive while staying connected to a collaborative, high-energy team through virtual-first rituals and regular in-person meetups.

Unlimited PTO: Trust-based time off so you can recharge and bring your best self to work.

Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage to support you and your family’s health and well-being.

Learning & development programs: Access to training, mentorship, and development resources to grow your skills — from HR operations to total rewards strategy.

At Employ, we believe that when people from different backgrounds and perspectives come together, amazing things happen. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, respected, and able to thrive.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that when people feel they belong, they can do their best work and we want every member of our team to feel that sense of belonging.

If you need accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please reach out. We’ll be glad to support you.

Recruitment Fraud Notice:

Employ takes candidate safety seriously. Please be aware that Employ recruiters and interviewers will only communicate with candidates using official email addresses ending in @employinc.com.

We will never ask for payment, banking information, or personal financial details at any stage of the hiring process, and we do not conduct interviews via messaging apps or social media platforms.

jobs.title: Savvy Commercial and Operations Senior Manager - UK/Poland
jobs.description:
Savvy Commercial and Operations Senior Manager - UK/Poland

This is not a back-office role. As a senior member of our globally distributed team, you’ll own the commercial and operational decisions that shape how Laminar wins work, delivers it and grows.

We're looking for a Commercial and Operations Senior Manager to strengthen the foundations of the business. That means tightening our commercial contracts, bringing structure to our operating procedures, and building processes that scale as we grow. If you enjoy untangling complex commercial and operational problems and turning them into clear, repeatable ways of working, we'd like to hear from you. This role requires someone with both commercial and operational experience.

If this sounds like you, Read on!

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

___________________________________________________________

We are Laminar Projects!

We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it)

We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of place that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 170 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job,” we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life: 

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:  

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

___________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

As Commercial and Operations Senior Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in protecting and growing Laminar's commercial position, as well as strengthening and continually improving our operational procedures. You'll own the frameworks that govern how we contract with clients and suppliers, manage commercial risk, and run the operations and commercial functions day to day. You'll be the person who makes sure our growth rests on sound contracts, clear policies and efficient operations. That gives our consultants the freedom to focus on delivering great work for clients.

Team

This is partly a new function, and you'll be building the commercial side of it from the ground up. You'll set its direction, shape its ways of working and grow the team over time. You'll work closely with leadership, group operations, delivery, bids, finance and people teams to make sure the Laminar operations and commercial function gives high-quality support across Laminar.

Your top three objectives

  1. Get our contracts up to standard. Review and standardise Laminar's client and supplier contract templates, terms and approval processes, so that commercial risk is understood, controlled and consistently managed.
  2. Build a robust operating model. Document, streamline and embed the core operational procedures (such as contract lifecycle, onboarding of clients and associates, and commercial reporting) so the business runs predictably as we scale.
  3. Establish the operations and commercial function as a trusted partner. Set up the governance, tools and reporting that give leadership clear visibility of performance, risk and opportunity. This should support better decisions on pricing, bids and growth.

Your top five responsibilities

  • Build a strong Laminar operations and commercial function: Design and lead Laminar's operational and commercial functions, covering its structure, processes, tools and ways of working, so it can support a growing, globally distributed business.
  • Commercial and operational management: Own the end-to-end contract lifecycle: drafting, negotiation, review, approval, change control and renewal. Oversee commercial risk, pricing inputs, supplier and associate agreements, and operational performance.
  • Develop and enforce policies: Create, maintain and embed clear commercial and operational policies and procedures, such as delegated authority, contract approvals, risk management and compliance. Make sure they are understood and followed across the business.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work with leadership, delivery, bids, finance and people teams to give practical commercial advice. That includes supporting bids and proposals, resolving contractual issues, and making sure commercial decisions support client outcomes.
  • Functional leadership and promoting culture: Lead by example as a senior member of the team. Build a culture of commercial awareness, accountability and continuous improvement, and coach others so good commercial practice becomes part of how Laminar works.

Your Capabilities

You'll be a proven commercial and operations leader who can switch easily between strategist, project manager, negotiator, communicator and doer to make things better. As a candidate, you should have:

Must-Have (The fundamentals)

  • Mastery: Significant experience in operations management and commercial and contract management, ideally in a consultancy or professional services setting. You're confident drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts and managing contractual risk.
  • Communication: A precise, structured communicator in English, both written and verbal. You can explain complex issues clearly to non-specialists and senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership: You can manage multiple projects and priorities at once, make sound judgement calls, and work well with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Impact: A track record of improving how organisations work, going well beyond the basics.

Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now, you will after joining)

  • Mastery: Experience with commercial contract reviews and commercial management. A relevant qualification (e.g legal or commercial degree]) is a plus.
  • Global perspective: Experience supporting a distributed or multi-jurisdiction business, including contracting across different regions.
  • Leadership: A proven leader, coach or developer of teams, ideally with experience building a new function from scratch.
  • Impact: A track record of putting in place scalable, repeatable commercial and operational solutions, such as contract management systems, approval workflows or reporting frameworks, that made a significant positive difference to a business.

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

___________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft
  • Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels - and do your bit for the environment

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

___________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

  • Why do you want to join us?
  • If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders. In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.description:

jobs.description:
Manager (m/w/d) Bildung für die kommunale Beratung und Prozessbegleitung

Die Europäische Metropolregion Nürnberg ist eine von elf Metropolregionen in Deutschland. Als leistungsfähiger Standort und Heimat für talentierte und engagierte Menschen aus aller Welt entwickelt sie sich stetig weiter. 11 Kreisfreie Städte, 23 Landkreise sowie rund 170 Unternehmen und Kammern aus Nordbayern haben sich zusammengeschlossen. Diese Allianz aus Politik und Wirtschaft ist über den gemeinnützigen Verein EMN Europäische Metropolregion Nürnberg e.V. organisiert. Die Geschäftsstelle hat ihren Sitz im Wirtschaftsrathaus in der Theresienstr. 9 in Nürnberg.

Mit Förderung des Bundesministeriums für Bildung und Forschung richtet die Metropolregion im Verbund mit dem Deutschen Jugendinstitut die „Regionale Entwicklungsagentur kommunales Bildungsmanagement (REAB) Bayern“ ein. Als Teil des bundesweiten Fachnetzwerks „Kommunales Bildungsmanagement“ berät die Agentur Landkreise und kreisfreie Städte zu einer strategischen Weiterentwicklung kommunaler Bildungslandschaften, sowohl organisational im Hinblick auf ein kommunales Bildungsmanagement, sowohl organisational im Hinblick auf ein kommunales Bildungsmanagement als auch thematisch-inhaltlich im Hinblick auf eine analog-digitale Vernetzung sowie in bildungsbezogenen Schwerpunkten.

Die Europäische Metropolregion Nürnberg sucht einen Manger (m/w/d) Bildung im Bereich wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit für die kommunale Beratung und Prozessbegleitung, Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD. Die Stelle ist ab dem 01.01.2027 in Teilzeit mit 19,5 Wochenarbeitsstunden zu besetzen und bis 31.01.2028 als Elternzeitvertretung befristet. Beschäftigungsort ist Nürnberg.

Aufgaben

  • Strategie-, Change- und Organisationsberatung von Kommunen zur organisationalen und inhaltlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer kommunalen Bildungslandschaften und/oder

  • Fachberatung von Kommunen zu bildungsbezogenen Schwerpunkten (z. B. hinsichtlich Fachkräftesicherung, Bildung für nachhaltige Entwicklung, kulturelle und demokratische Bildung, Integration, Inklusion und Ganztagsbildung) sowie zu einer analog-digital vernetzten Bildungslandschaft

  • Prozessbegleitung von Kommunen beim Auf- und Ausbau von Strukturen für ein kommunales Bildungsmanagement

  • Konzeptionelle Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Moderation von Qualifizierungsworkshops, Arbeitsgemeinschaften und Fachkonferenzen

  • Auf- und Ausbau bildungsbezogener Kommunikations- und Netzwerkstrukturen

  • Beteiligung an Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und Wissensmanagement der Entwicklungsagentur sowie im bundesweiten Fachnetzwerk kommunales Bildungsmanagement, inkl. Mitwirkung an fachbezogenen Publikationen

Qualifikation

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master, Diplom oder vergleichbarer Abschluss) vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Organisationsentwicklung, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Pädagogik oder Politikwissenschaften

  • Erfahrung in der verantwortlichen Begleitung von Organisationsentwicklungsprozessen und/oder

  • Fachliche Erfahrungen in kommunal verantworteten Bildungsbereichen, z.B. Fachkräftesicherung, Bildung für nachhaltige Entwicklung, kulturelle und demokratische Bildung, Integration, Inklusion, Ganztagsbildung sowie analog-digital vernetzten Bildungslandschaften

  • Erfahrung in der Lehre und Qualifizierung, z.B. durch die verantwortliche Durchführung von Lehrveranstaltungen, Coachings oder Qualifizierungen

  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative und organisatorische Fähigkeiten, Kreativität, Konzeptionsstärke, eine selbstständige und effiziente Arbeitsweise sowie Kollegialität und Teamfähigkeit

  • Erfahrungen mit einem kommunalen Bildungsmanagement inkl. Bildungsmonitoring wünschenswert

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Betreuung von Netzwerken wünschenswert

  • Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Verwaltungs- und Arbeitsstrukturen, bei Bildungsanbietern oder einschlägigen Forschungseinrichtungen wünschenswert

Benefits

  • Ein kollegiales und aufgeschlossenes Team

  • Vielseitige, spannende und herausfordernde Aufgaben sowie eine eigenverantwortliche Tätigkeit

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie mit der Möglichkeit von Homeoffice

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Bitte reichen Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnisse) bis spätestens 02.12.2026 über unsere Bewerbungsplattform Join ein.

Für fachliche Rückfragen zum Projekt „Regionale Entwicklungsagentur kommunales Bildungsmanagement“ wenden Sie sich bitte an den Projektleiter Florian Neumann, Tel.: 0911/231-10516.

Informationen zur Metropolregion finden Sie unter unserer Homepage.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Supplier Quality Manager (all genders)

Your role


As our Supplier Quality Manager (all genders) within the Product & Materials Quality team, you will take full ownership of raw material and supplier quality, ensuring that all incoming ingredients and external processes meet stringent quality standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations while driving continuous improvement across our supply chain.

  • Own end-to-end Supplier Qualification & Performance: Manage the full lifecycle of raw material supplier qualification - including initial audits, approvals, and maintaining the Approved Supplier List - while tracking and trending supplier performance metrics.

  • Lead Non-Conformance & CAPA Resolution: Investigate, document, and resolve quality non-conformances for incoming raw materials. Issue supplier complaints and apply structured problem-solving methodologies (e.g., 8D, 5 Whys, Root Cause Analysis) to verify effective Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

  • Drive Specification & Documentation Control: Approve raw material specifications in close collaboration with Product Development and Purchasing, and review critical supplier documentation such as Certificates of Analysis (COAs), Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and regulatory declarations.

  • Oversee Incoming Quality & Compliance: Manage and continuously optimize the Incoming Inspection process including sampling plans (e.g., AQL) and ensure all materials and processes comply with internal specifications, industry standards (e.g., ISO, GMP), and applicable regulations.

  • Embed Proactive Risk Management: Conduct and participate in risk assessments (such as FMEA) to proactively identify, evaluate, and mitigate quality risks across raw materials and external supplier processes.

  • Strengthen QMS & Audit Readiness: Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of Quality Management System (QMS) policies, procedures, and work instructions, while leading and supporting internal and external supplier/process audits.

  • Leverage Data for Continuous Improvement: Collect, analyze, and report on key quality KPIs (such as percentage of non-conforming deliveries), applying statistical methods and Lean principles to enhance quality, boost efficiency, and reduce waste.

Your profile

  • A degree in Food Science, Food Engineering,Food Safety, or a related field

  • 1-2+ years of experience in supplier quality, QA, or raw material management - ideally in food, supplements, FMCG, or pharma.

  • Hands-on experience with QMS frameworks, regulatory standards (ISO, GMP), risk assessments (FMEA), incoming inspection sampling (AQL), and root-cause tools (8D, 5 Whys, CAPA).

  • Comfortable tracking, analyzing, and interpreting quality KPIs to spot trends, assess supplier risk, and translate findings into concrete corrective actions.

  • Confident collaborating across Product Development, Purchasing, Operations, and external suppliers to align specifications, resolve issues, and drive decisions forward.

  • Meticulous when reviewing technical documentation (COAs, MSDS, specifications) and skilled at building or refining scalable quality processes.

  • Proficiency in standard quality/ERP systems and data tools; hands-on familiarity with AI tools (such as Claude or Gemini) to streamline workflows and analysis is a strong advantage.

  • Fluent in English (C1 level), German is a plus.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

 

We are looking forward to your application!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.
