jobs.description:
Senior Performance Marketing Manager Paid Social – Meta & TikTok (m/w/d) · Remote

Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du möchtest E-Commerce-Brands über Meta und TikTok profitabel zum Wachsen bringen? Paid Social ist bei vielen unserer Kunden der entscheidende Wachstumskanal. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn zu verantworten und auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets zu skalieren. Unser internes Team aus Creative Strategist, Copywriting, Grafik, Video- und Landingpage-Spezialisten unterstützt dich dabei.

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Mittwochmorgen. Im Business Manager laufen zwei neue Hooks deutlich über Benchmark. Du erhöhst die Budgets und briefst das Creative Team auf Iterationen der Best Performer. Daraus entsteht ein neues Set aus UGC, Founder Ads und Statics, das wenige Tage später live geht.

Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance, die nächsten Schritte und deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Funnel. Danach briefst du dein Team, jeder Schritt ist klar verteilt.

Drei Tage nach dem Launch steht ein Performance-Uplift von 30 %, der Account skaliert auf 3.000 € Ad Spend am Tag, profitabel bei stabilem CAC. Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote ab Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert Paid Social bei EVOLVE

Dass Creatives über die Performance entscheiden, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel für unsere Kunden mit. Denn Skalierung entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads, sondern auch aus dem Angebot dahinter.

  • Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht

  • Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Ad verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter

  • Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer

  • KI als Werkzeug im Alltag. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Du arbeitest damit wie mit einem Junior an deiner Seite, von der Creative-Recherche bis zur Auswertung

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung

  • Skalierung: Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend

  • Creative: Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit dem Creative Team. Welche Hooks, Formate und Angebote gelauncht werden, entscheidest du

  • Testing: Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Denn ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohem Ad-Spend-Level nicht lange

  • Datenanalyse: Du bewertest alle Maßnahmen anhand der Performance-Daten

  • Kunden: Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst Kunden ganzheitlich, nicht nur auf Kanalebene

  • Aufbau des Bereichs: Du entwickelst Social Ads weiter, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien und entscheidest, was getestet wird. Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

Volta builds and operates large-scale AI compute infrastructure, working with institutional investors, lenders and customers across multiple jurisdictions. We are seeking a commercially minded Tax Director to lead cross-border structuring and the delivery of the UK and global tax team.

Reporting to the VP of Tax, you will turn agreed tax strategy into practical structures and oversee technical quality across transactions, international tax and non-US tax operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for a broad corporate tax specialist who can resolve complex questions and help a growing team deliver.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead the design and implementation of cross-border investment, holding, operating and financing structures, including joint ventures, capital raises, acquisitions, re-financings and exits.

  • Review project underwriting and tax models, challenging assumptions on cash taxes, tax depreciation, financing, losses, withholding taxes and repatriation before commitments are made.

  • Oversee group structuring for development and management fees, intercompany funding and profit allocation, working with the Corporate and International Tax team on transfer pricing and operating substance.

  • Manage and develop the three UK and global Senior Managers, set priorities and review significant technical conclusions across their workstreams.

  • Work with the US Tax Director on cross-border projects and group policies, agreeing a clear tax lead and deliverables for each transaction.

  • Oversee the non-US compliance and reporting framework through the Compliance and Operations Senior Manager, reviewing significant tax accounting and indirect tax judgements.

  • Review transaction documents, commercial agreements and implementation steps with Legal, Finance, Treasury, Capital Markets and Corporate Development.

  • Direct external advisers on agreed workstreams, challenge recommendations and fees, and maintain clear records of decisions and implementation requirements.

  • Present recommendations to the VP of Tax, escalating material structural changes, uncertain positions and commercial risks for approval under the group's decision framework.

What You Bring

International Indirect Tax Manager

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

Forming part of the tax team, you will own the day-to-day management of Volta's indirect tax affairs in all jurisdictions outside the US, including VAT/GST, customs duties, excise taxes and property taxes, as applicable. You will combine hands-on compliance and process ownership with practical indirect tax advice on business operations, commercial transactions, capital investment and new projects.

You will work closely with finance, procurement, commercial, legal and external advisers to ensure indirect taxes are correctly assessed, charged, recovered and reported, and that available exemptions and reliefs are identified, documented and implemented.

This is an opportunity for an experienced indirect tax specialist to build scalable processes within a fast-growing, global AI infrastructure business and directly influence the tax cost and cash flow of major infrastructure investments.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own indirect tax compliance across all jurisdictions in which Volta operates outside the US, including registrations, returns, payments, reconciliations and responses to tax notices, coordinating with local advisers and service providers.

  • Assess registration obligations, place of supply, taxability and reverse charge requirements for Volta's business activities and commercial arrangements.

  • Partner with procurement and project teams to establish the appropriate indirect tax treatment of purchases of goods and services before orders are placed.

  • Identify and implement available tax recovery opportunities, exemptions, reliefs and import VAT/GST arrangements, working with external advisers to confirm eligibility and ongoing requirements.

  • Manage tax invoices and supporting documentation for both purchases and customer sales, including evidence for cross-border transactions, validation and retention.

  • Review customer and supplier contracts with legal and commercial teams, advising on indirect tax clauses, invoicing, recovery requirements and responsibility for tax assessments.

  • Establish transaction review processes to identify indirect taxes that have not been accounted for or have been charged or recovered incorrectly and pursue refunds or corrections where appropriate.

  • Lead indirect tax audits and enquiries, coordinating responses, supporting evidence and external advisers.

  • Build and maintain indirect tax guidance, compliance calendars, controls and data requirements, and support the implementation of tax technology, e-invoicing, digital reporting and automation.

  • Monitor legislative changes and assess their impact on existing operations and new projects, providing clear recommendations and supporting the business teams.

  • Support finance with indirect tax accounting, account reconciliations, budgeting, cash flow forecasts and financial audit requirements, including the timing of VAT/GST recovery and refunds.

  • Advise on the indirect tax implications of cross-border and intercompany arrangements, property leases and entry into new countries, coordinating with local specialists where needed.

  • Manage customs duties, excise taxes and property tax matters, coordinating with specialist advisers on import procedures and other relevant local taxes.

What You Bring

  • Strong experience in VAT/GST and other indirect taxes across multiple jurisdictions outside the US within a business, Big 4 or specialist tax advisory firm.

Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. Rotterdam - Als Manager Redactionele Strategie & Analyse ben je een analytisch zwaargewicht en verantwoordelijk voor de strategie en prioritering binnen het cluster. Je realiseert duurzame digitale groei door data-inzichten strategisch te verankeren binnen een specifiek cluster van titels. Je fungeert daarnaast als de onmisbare schakel tussen het centrale RI&G-team en de lokale redacties. Jouw rol focust zich op het Algemeen Dagblad (AD) en 7 regiotitels, zoals De Stentor of De Gelderlander. 

Wie zijn wij?
Wij zijn de afdeling Redactionele inzichten & groei (RI&G). Binnen de divisie Nieuwsmedia & Magazines zijn wij dé strategische partner voor de redacties. We leveren niet zomaar losse adviezen of rapportages aan, maar we realiseren duurzame digitale groei door data-inzichten strategisch te verankeren binnen onze mediatitels.

We fungeren als de onmisbare schakel tussen het centrale expertisecentrum en de dagelijkse praktijk op de lokale redacties. Door complexe datasets te vertalen naar een helder, strategisch verhaal, maken we redactionele besluitvorming inzichtelijk en stevig onderbouwd. Zo helpen we de redacties om redactionele en operationele kansen in één oogopslag te signaleren en bepalen we samen de digitale koers van onze nieuwsmerken.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Cluster-regie & Prioritering: Je beheert de roadmap voor het gehele cluster en bepaalt welke projecten en centrale data-innovaties prioriteit krijgen.

  • Team Performance & Coaching: Je geeft direct leiding aan een team van lokale analisten, coacht hen in hun rol als strategisch partner voor titels en bevordert de zelfredzaamheid van de redacties.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
Field Marketing Manager, EMEA

About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, based in London, to build and run Ema’s on-the-ground presence across the UK and Europe. You’ll cover industry events, tradeshows, executive dinners and sponsored programs in our priority markets: the UK, France, DACH and Benelux, with the Nordics and wider Europe as they grow. You’ll be the connective tissue between our BDR, Sales, AI Strategy, Product Marketing and Design teams, turning live experiences into qualified pipeline.

You’ll be Ema’s first field marketer in the region, working alongside our US Field Marketing Manager. Our Marketing Lead sets the global event strategy and budget. Within that, you own the UK and Europe calendar: which events we back, which cities we show up in, and how we run them. Then you execute it.

We need someone who thrives in startup environments, moves fast, and doesn’t wait for permission to solve problems. If you’ve built field programs across more than one European market, know how to get scrappy when budgets are tight, and can run a booth in London one week and an executive dinner in Paris the next, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Event Planning

  • Build and maintain the UK and Europe event calendar within the global strategy and budget set by our Marketing Lead.

  • Recommend which conferences, tradeshows and sponsorships to back in each market, based on target accounts, pipeline and cost. Know the difference between an event that matters in London and one that matters in Munich or Amsterdam.

  • Work with the US Field Marketing Manager to share what works, reuse playbooks and assets, and keep the two programs consistent.

Event Execution & Operations

  • Plan, manage and execute end-to-end logistics for industry conferences, tradeshows and Ema-hosted events (executive roundtables, dinners, meetups) across the UK and Europe.

  • Manage all on-site operations: booth design, staffing, signage, swag, shipping, A/V, catering and speaker logistics. You’re the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Handle the cross-border details that US events don’t have: shipping and customs between the UK and the EU, local venues and suppliers, and GDPR-compliant lead capture.

  • Evaluate sponsorship opportunities, negotiate vendor contracts and manage event budgets to maximise ROI.

Pipeline & Sales Alignment

  • Work with the BDR team and Sales to align event programming with target accounts and pipeline goals in each market.

  • Coordinate pre-event outreach, booth and event activations, and post-event follow-up to drive lead conversion.

  • Make sure every event lead reaches Sales quickly and cleanly. No leads die on the vine.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with AI Strategists, Product Marketing and Design so demos, collateral and messaging are event-ready, on-brand and right for the local audience.

  • Support broader demand-generation campaigns as needed, including regional activations and partner co-marketing events.

  • Work across time zones with US-based marketing and leadership, with some early-evening calls.

Measurement & Optimisation

  • Track and report on event performance by market (leads generated, pipeline influenced, cost per lead, attendance, deal acceleration) and share insights to improve the program.

  • Obsess over what’s working vs. what’s noise, and use data to make the case for where we invest next.

What You Bring

  • 5–7+ years of field marketing, event marketing or demand-gen experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology, with a track record of running events in the UK and at least one other European market. Startup experience is required. You’ve built programs, not just inherited them.

  • A working knowledge of the European event circuit and what each market expects, from London tech weeks to Paris and DACH industry shows.

  • Exceptional project management skills. You can juggle 5+ events in different countries and stages at once without dropping a ball. You live in spreadsheets, timelines and run-of-show docs.

  • A roll-up-your-sleeves operator. You’re the person zip-tying cables to a booth at 6 AM, getting a pallet of swag through customs, and sending the recap email before the Eurostar pulls in.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You partner naturally with Sales, BDRs, Product Marketing and executives, including colleagues eight hours behind you, without needing to be managed into it.

  • Experience with HubSpot and marketing automation platforms to track attribution and ROI, and a practical grasp of GDPR as it applies to event data.

  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to speed up day-to-day work, from drafting event briefs to analysing post-event data. We’re an AI company and we expect you to work like one.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-moving environments. Priorities shift, budgets change, events get added last minute, and you handle it. This is a fast growing Series B company. If you need a playbook handed to you, this isn’t the role.

  • High agency and an ownership mindset. As our first field marketer in Europe, you’ll see gaps and fill them without waiting to be asked.

Location & Travel

  • Based in/near London, working hybrid from our London office.

  • Travel up to 40% across the UK and Europe, with occasional trips to the US.

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

At 1Password, we want our Go-To-Market teams to have the best tools, data, and AI available. We're looking for a Staff GTM Engineer to join Revenue Operations and own the architecture, development, and operation of the AI applications, agents, and data pipelines across our sales, marketing, and customer success stack.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional engineering role. You'll write and ship production code, set the technical direction for AI in GTM, and bring engineering rigor to the work: architecture reviews, testing, CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery), and observability. You'll work closely with operations, systems, analytics, engineering, and security teams to turn ideas into reliable services that help revenue teams work faster and smarter.

Reporting into the Senior Director, GTM Engineering, this role is a remote opportunity within Canada and the USA.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

• Bring 6 or more years of engineering experience, including ownership of production tools from initial design through deployment and ongoing operation.

• Work directly with GTM workflows and systems such as Salesforce, Clay, HubSpot, Outreach, Gong, and Gainsight, including their application programming interfaces (APIs) and data models.

• Build production agentic applications using prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, tool calling, evaluation frameworks, and observability.

• Translate business goals and pain points into clear technical requirements, explain tradeoffs in plain language, and collaborate effectively with non-technical GTM leaders and cross-functional partners.

• Write clean, tested, maintainable code and apply strong engineering practices, including version control, code review, debugging, and consistent coding standards.

• Deploy and operate production services on Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), using containers or serverless infrastructure, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), monitoring, and alerting.

• Use Structured Query Language (SQL) and data modeling to build reliable data pipelines between systems.

What you can expect:

  • Ship AI into the revenue workflow: Design, build, and run production agents and services for lead scoring, enrichment, routing, summarization, and personalized outreach across GTM systems.

  • Own the GTM technical roadmap: Partner with RevOps and GTM leaders to find and prioritize the use cases worth building, and make the build vs. buy and architecture calls behind them

  • Build the platform others build on: Create shared APIs, integrations, and data pipelines that connect revenue systems, so each new use case ships faster than the last

  • Make AI measurable and safe to change: Put evaluations, monitoring, and staged rollouts around every AI workflow, and partner with Security and IT to protect customer data

  • Set the engineering bar for GTM: Establish standards for code review, linting, testing, CI/CD, and documentation. Mentor engineers and technical operators

  • Run what you build: Join the on-call rotation for your systems and lead incident response and follow-up fixes

This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

We are hiring a Founding Performance Marketing Lead to own performance and growth marketing from the ground up. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to build the machine - not inherit one.

You will own the path from first impression to click to conversion to qualified pipeline to closed ARR. That includes paid acquisition, creative testing, landing pages, attribution, funnel instrumentation, conversion-rate optimization, audience discovery, and early product-led growth experiments.

You will work directly with Neuroscale's founders and partner closely with Product, Design, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will have the autonomy to test quickly, scale what works, stop what does not, and turn learning into repeatable playbooks.

What You'll Own

1. Build and scale the paid acquisition engine

Launch, manage, and optimize acquisition across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, retargeting, and emerging channels. Personally manage meaningful media spend and make channel decisions based on pipeline quality, acquisition economics, and revenue - not vanity metrics.

2. Turn creative into a growth system

Build a high-velocity testing engine across short-form video, UGC, founder-led creative, static ads, customer proof, use-case creative, case studies, and landing-page concepts. Develop a repeatable process for creative briefs, production, testing, learning, and iteration.

3. Own the conversion funnel

Build and continuously improve the journey from ad to landing page to demo or trial to activation. Create and ship landing pages without waiting on a large web team, and work with Product and Design to remove friction from high-intent conversion paths.

4. Make measurement and attribution decision-grade

Own campaign tracking, UTMs, pixels, events, conversion APIs, CRM campaign logic, attribution models, dashboards, and funnel reporting. Create a clear view of what is producing qualified pipeline, what is wasting spend, and where conversion is breaking down.

5. Run a disciplined experimentation program

Design and execute continuous A/B and multivariate tests across hooks, creative, copy, audiences, offers, landing pages, CTAs, forms, demo flows, and channel mix. Maintain an experiment backlog and use data to decide what to scale, iterate, or kill.

6. Discover and codify our best audiences

Identify the ICP signals, personas, use cases, pain points, messages, offers, and targeting strategies that consistently produce high-quality opportunities. Turn those findings into reusable audience and messaging playbooks for Marketing and Sales.

7. Help shape product-led growth

Partner with Product and Revenue on activation, self-serve conversion, trial-to-paid pathways, in-product prompts, lifecycle nudges, and other early PLG loops that can complement the sales-led motion.

8. Automate for leverage

Use AI, no-code/low-code tools, enrichment, workflow automation, and light scripting to increase testing velocity and reduce repetitive work. Build a marketing operating system that can test 20 thoughtful ideas where a traditional team might test two.

The Numbers You'll Care About

  1. Qualified Pipeline

  2. CAC / CAC Payback

  3. CPL / Cost per Qualified Lead

  4. ARR Sourced / Influenced

  5. Conversion Rate

  6. LTV / CAC

  7. Pipeline Velocity

  8. Experiment Win Rate

Clicks, CTR, engagement, and reach matter only when they help explain the economics of acquiring customers and creating revenue.

Who We're Looking For

  • 4-8+ years of hands-on performance marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, HR Tech, recruiting technology, or another high-growth technology category.

  • A track record of personally managing and scaling approximately $50K-$250K+ per month in paid media across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, or comparable channels - and translating that spend into qualified pipeline and revenue.

  • Deep hands-on experience inside ad platforms. You can build campaigns, audiences, conversion tracking, creative tests, budgets, bids, and optimization logic yourself.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect channel spend to downstream funnel performance, opportunity creation, pipeline, and ARR.

  • Strong command of funnel economics, including CPL, CAC, LTV, CAC payback, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and marginal acquisition efficiency.

  • Experience building and improving landing pages, forms, demo flows, or trial experiences with a strong CRO mindset.

  • Strong creative instincts and copy judgment. You can diagnose why a message or creative concept is working - not merely report that CTR changed.

  • Experience testing video, UGC, creator-led, founder-led, or short-form paid creative.

  • Comfort with analytics, dashboards, CRM data, experimentation, attribution, and imperfect early-stage datasets.

  • Ability to move quickly from hypothesis to launch to data to insight to the next test.

  • Strong written communication and the ability to translate customer pain into clear, high-converting messaging.

  • A builder mentality: high ownership, low ego, strong judgment, and a preference for creating the playbook rather than waiting for one.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Built performance marketing from near-zero at an early-stage or high-growth B2B SaaS company.

  • Scaled one or more paid channels into a predictable source of qualified pipeline while maintaining disciplined acquisition economics.

  • Experience in HR Tech, recruiting technology, AI, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or another complex B2B category.

  • Built a UGC, creator, customer-proof, or founder-led creative program that materially improved paid performance.

  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce; Webflow or Framer; GA4; Segment; Mixpanel or Amplitude; Clay; Zapier or Make; and modern attribution or ad-tracking tools.

  • Built lightweight automations, scripts, dashboards, or AI-assisted workflows yourself.

  • Worked with Product teams on PLG, free-trial, self-service, lifecycle, or activation experiments.

  • Used AI tools systematically to accelerate research, creative production, analysis, personalization, and experimentation.

You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want meaningful ownership and are energized by a blank sheet of paper.

  • You enjoy being in the campaigns, creative, landing pages, dashboards, and funnel - not only managing vendors.

  • You are comfortable being accountable for qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • You prefer fast, instrumented experiments over long planning cycles.

  • You can balance speed with analytical rigor and know when the data is strong enough to act.

  • You are resourceful and can ship with a small team while building systems that scale.

What Success Looks Like

  • A repeatable paid acquisition engine is producing qualified demand at increasingly predictable economics.

  • Campaign-to-CRM attribution provides a credible view from spend through opportunity, pipeline, and revenue.

  • Creative and landing-page experiments are shipping every week with documented learnings.

  • Neuroscale has a clear picture of its highest-converting ICPs, personas, messages, offers, and channel combinations.

  • Landing-page, demo/trial, and funnel conversion rates are improving through systematic experimentation.

  • CAC and payback are understood by channel and audience, with clear thresholds for scaling spend.

  • A measurable content and creative engine supports paid acquisition rather than operating as a separate activity stream.

  • Marketing, Product, Sales, and Revenue Operations share a common funnel definition and growth scorecard.

  • A documented growth playbook compounds as spend, headcount, and market coverage increase.

Why Neuroscale

Build at the moment growth becomes the priority. The product foundation is in place. The opportunity now is to build the acquisition engine that can turn strong technology into a category-defining company.

Founding-level ownership. You will not be optimizing someone else's mature playbook. The systems, experiments, and operating cadence you create can become the foundation of Neuroscale's future growth organization.

Direct access to the founders. Work closely with company leadership with very little organizational friction between a strong idea and testing it in market.

AI-native environment. You will market an AI company inside a team that expects AI to be embedded in how research, creative, analysis, automation, and decision-making get done.

High autonomy with clear accountability. This is a high-trust role for someone who wants the freedom to move quickly and the responsibility to own measurable outcomes.

A path to broader growth leadership. This role is designed to expand with results, with a fast path toward Head of Growth as the company scales.

The Opportunity

Most performance marketing roles ask you to improve an existing engine by 10-20%. This role gives you the chance to build the engine.

The campaigns you launch, audiences you discover, creative systems you create, attribution infrastructure you establish, and growth loops you uncover can define how Neuroscale acquires customers for years.

Compensation & Growth

This is a founding-level, high-impact role with compensation designed to align with measurable growth and long-term value creation. Specific base compensation, performance incentives, equity or long-term participation, and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates and finalized based on experience, location, and employment structure.

The role is designed to create a path toward broader Head of Growth leadership as Neuroscale scales.

How We Hire

We value evidence of outcomes over polished marketing language. Strong candidates should be prepared to walk through campaigns they personally built, the economics behind them, what they tested, what failed, what they changed, and how those decisions affected pipeline or revenue.

  • Introductory conversation focused on fit, ownership, and growth-stage experience.

  • Deep dive into one or two performance programs you personally operated.

  • Practical working session or case discussion focused on audience, creative, funnel, and measurement strategy.

  • Final conversation with the founders on scope, operating style, and growth mandate.

Equal Opportunity

Neuroscale AI is committed to building a team based on capability, potential, and impact. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates who need them during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Manager
jobs.description:
Clinical Trial Manager

Precision for Medicine is looking for an experienced Clinical Trial Manager to join our growing team. Candidates can work remotely in Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, UK or Spain.

Precision for Medicine is a precision medicine CRO. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas.

You will be the hub of central intelligence for the studies you will be managing and will lead CRAs and oversee all clinical aspects of your study across multiple countries, ensuring timeline adherence and scope, whilst ensuring quality delivery. We encourage high-energy, dedicated professionals who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments to explore this opportunity.

We are addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology and are dedicated to positively impacting the health and lives of patients around the world. If you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in the trial operational delivery process, don't miss exploring working with us.

About You:

  • You love having responsibility and a say in how clinical trials are run
  • You plan ahead, but have alternative options and a flexible approach
  • You are client focused
  • You are well organised and able to manage timelines and shifting priorities, without sacrificing quality.
  • You communicate clearly, often and concisely and know that your role is crucial in keeping the trial running smoothly
  • You are a master at identifying any risks that threaten projects and handle them resolutely
  • You thrive and work with autonomy and ownership to deliver successful outcomes

The day-to-day role, and how we will support your continued growth:

  • Management and operational delivery of the clinical elements within a trial including site selection, start-up, enrolment management, site engagement and support, monitoring planning and execution, data cleaning activities and close-out
  • Successful execution of assigned trials and ensuring completion of trial deliverables
  • Ensure appropriate communication, regulatory documentation, and ongoing oversight of assigned trial(s) by working in close collaboration with other functional team members
  • Mentoring and training of team members
  • Identify challenges to study timelines/deliverables and offer creative action plans to the team/sponsor
  • Lead CRAs as they establish relationships with their sites for high quality oversight of monitoring, regulatory, IP, site payment and overall site correspondence activities
  • Maintain team focus on study priorities through efficient cross-functional partnerships and effective communication to achieve the highest level of client satisfaction

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health-related field, including experience in the field of oncology

Other Required:

  • Demonstrable experience leading clinical aspects of your studies across multiple countries in a CRO / Pharma or Biotech company (in a dedicated 'clinical lead' role).
  • Significant clinical trial management experience in the area of oncology
  • Experience with CAR-T and Radiopharmaceuticals would be a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process
  • Availability for domestic and international travel including overnight stays
  • Must be able to communicate effectively in the English language

Skills:

  • Demonstrated computer skills (MS Office, MS Project, PowerPoint) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop positive working relationships with internal and external organizations
  • Demonstrates core understanding of medical terminology and clinical trial activities as it relates to the execution of a clinical development plan

Competencies:

  • Demonstrates mastery knowledge of ICH-GCP, meaningful Precision SOPs, and regulatory guidance, as well as the ability to implement

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real‑time, multimodal AI to create a digital twin of both the resident and the care environment, giving care providers clear visibility into what is happening at the bedside. Our technology removes the administrative and observational workload that slows care teams down, allowing them to focus on delivering exceptional care.

Through a combination of in‑room hardware and intuitive desktop and mobile applications, Teton supports a seamless experience for residents, carers and operators. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real‑time data, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that gives care teams actionable intelligence to make faster, safer and better‑informed decisions.

With strong demand and clear product‑market fit, we are scaling rapidly across the UK. This role offers a rare opportunity to land and shape the largest relationships in our highest‑potential region.

The Role

The Business Development Director will hunt and close Teton’s new business with the UK’s largest care operators: large care home groups, including national and multi‑regional operators and REIT‑backed portfolios, alongside strategic partners across the NHS and wider health and social care system.

This is a hunter role. You will own a focused portfolio of named target groups, open doors with senior decision‑makers and drive deals to signature with pace. Your focus is closing high six‑ to seven‑figure agreements that set the pace for Teton’s UK growth.



Key Responsibilities

New business

  • Prospect relentlessly into your named enterprise care groups and the portfolio owners behind them, through outbound, events and referrals. (Smaller groups are covered by our Business Development Managers.)

  • Own the full sales cycle from first meeting to signed contract, keeping deals moving through pilots, procurement and legal with urgency.

  • Consistently close high six‑ to seven‑figure, multi‑site agreements, converting pilots into paid, estate‑wide rollouts.

Executive relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with CEOs, COOs, CFOs, Directors of Quality and Clinical Directors, as well as investors and property owners behind operator portfolios.

  • Present compelling, outcome‑led business cases covering falls reduction, staffing efficiency, regulatory outcomes and ROI to boards and investment committees.

Partners and procurement

  • Use REIT, landlord, channel‑partner and NHS relationships to open doors and accelerate deals with target groups.

  • Lead or contribute to tenders and formal procurement processes, working with internal clinical, product and compliance teams.

Pipeline and forecasting

  • Build and maintain a high‑value enterprise pipeline with rigorous qualification, accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success and Account Management to ensure seamless handover and expansion across signed groups.

  • Represent Teton at senior industry forums, roundtables and sector events, turning every event into qualified pipeline.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience, including at least 3 years selling complex SaaS or technology‑enabled solutions into large, regulated organisations, ideally health or social care.

  • A consistent record of exceeding multi‑million‑pound new business quotas, including closing high six‑ to seven‑figure deals.

  • Experience driving multi‑stakeholder deals to close at pace, with board‑level sponsors, procurement and legal.

  • A strong network across UK care home groups, operator investors or the NHS, with credibility at C‑suite level.

  • Commercial acumen: comfortable building ROI models, structuring pilots and phased rollouts, and negotiating complex commercial terms.

  • Working knowledge of the UK care regulatory landscape (CQC, clinical safety standards such as DCB0129/0160, data protection) or the ability to get there quickly.

  • Experience with tenders, frameworks or public‑sector procurement is a strong advantage.

  • A true hunter: you open doors at the most senior level, build your own pipeline and are driven by closing. You thrive in high‑growth environments and take ownership.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

  • Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel across the UK, with occasional travel to Copenhagen.

  • Based in or near London, with regular presence in our London office.

What We Offer

  • Highly competitive base salary and uncapped commission, with a senior‑level OTE.

  • Participation in our warrant programme.

  • The chance to win the UK’s largest care groups in a fast‑scaling business.

  • The opportunity to work with state‑of‑the‑art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning‑focused environment with significant room for growth and impact.

What It’s Like Working at Teton

We are a high‑performing, fast‑moving team of ambitious people who care deeply about our mission. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged but expected. You will be challenged, supported and surrounded by people who take ownership and move quickly.

We are looking for individuals who believe in our long‑term vision and value entrepreneurship over a traditional nine‑to‑five. If you want a role where your work genuinely shapes the future of care delivery, and you are ready for the ride, we would love to meet you.
